**1) Core Responsibilities**
•	Implement scalable and robust Machine Learning systems computing on large volumes of datasets using a variety of open source and proprietary Data Science technologies,
•	Work with Data Scientists to implement data processing jobs and algorithms into production code,
•	Implement and integrate system components for service orchestration, scheduling, job status monitoring, model performance monitoring, failure recovery, APIs, and any other components required for a robust and reliable Machine Learning system spanning on-premises and cloud environments,
•	Write and automate unit, functional, integration and performance tests in a Continuous Integration environment,
•	Collaborate with product management, revenue, and solution delivery teams to ensure that customer requirements are well managed and reflected in product releases,
•	Support the deployment of Flow software within partner and client IT environments,
•	Work closely with stakeholders to ensure high standards of data governance during implementation.

 
**2) Qualifications & Skills**
•	3+ years of superior software development experience building commercial large-scale software systems.
•	Experience in developing complex end-to-end machine learning applications processing large volumes of data in multiple environments.
•	Excellence in algorithms, data structure, discrete math and distributed computing.
•	Experience with basic software development skills, such as agile methodologies, testing, version control, and CI/CD.
•	Demonstrated clear and thorough logical and analytical thinking, as well as problem solving skills.
•	Production coding and testing experience in choice of programming languages and Machine Learning development frameworks.
•	Proven professional experience in processing large-scale commercial data. Experience with voice/audio data a plus.
•	Experience with Cloud Infrastructure and Docker is a plus.
•	Superior and proactive communications skills, including verbal, written, and presentation.
•	Proven team player and contributor.
•	Self-directed, ability to work independently and research innovative solutions to technical and business problems.
•	Aptitude of working on multiple projects in parallel.
•	M.S. or B.S. degree in Computer Science / Engineering or equivalent is required for this position.
•	Proficiency in Python is a must.
•	Able to communicate and understand in English is a must.

**3) Salary & Benefits**
You will get the opportunity to work in a dynamic start-up environment to grow and develop your skills.
•	24 days of annual leave for you to travel and relax, 
•	Training and development programs for continuous learning,
•	Ability to make flexible work arrangements or conduct remote work,
•	Company events and activities to meet colleagues from other countries,
•	A meaningful career to better the lives of others,
•	Opportunities to advance your career horizontally and vertically.

**Our Values**
We believe that our core values are essential for cultivating a cohesive and high-performing work environment in the company. More importantly, our values reflect our vision of the community that we are striving to foster.
-	Ethical
o	Understanding the importance of our communities through responsible and moral decisions and actions.
-	Innovation
o	Seeking and applying new ideas to ensure efficiency, quality, and the readiness to address current and future needs.
-	Integrity
o	Being truthful, sincere, and free of deceit in our words, actions, and all business dealings.
-	Teamwork
o	Respecting the people in our team and our common goals by ensuring the cultivation of a collaborative and vibrant environment.
-	Humility
o	Remaining grounded to reality regardless of our statuses to recognize the strengths and potential of others.

## Ideal Candidate Profile
Highly experienced software development professional with 3+ years building large-scale commercial machine learning systems. Proficient in Python and adept at implementing robust and scalable ML solutions, including data processing, algorithm integration, and system component orchestration. Proven ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams, automate testing in a CI/CD environment, and ensure data governance standards are met. Dedicated to independent problem-solving and contributing as a team player to deliver innovative solutions in both on-premises and cloud environments.

KEY REQUIREMENTS: 

    • AWS Cloud Guru: 4+ years experience working with some subset of AWS services, such as: EC2, RDS, DynamoDB, Elasticsearch, ElasticBeanstalk, Lambda, Cloudwatch, SQS, Kinesis and SNS
    • 5 year experience with some subset of our primary tech stack: Ruby on Rails, Node, React (or other Javascript frameworks), Postgres, Redis. 
    • Fluent in English. Communicate easily with our North American teams.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
    • Architect and build. First and foremost, you will be building and architecting new web applications and microservices that are required, as well as creating new features on our existing applications.
    • Make recommendations. You will play an active role in the way we make decisions around technologies to be used for new applications and improvements on existing applications
    •  Working with both SQL and NoSQL databases (Postgres, Elasticsearch, DynamoDB, MongoDB, Cassandra, etc.). You’ve also been around the Javascript block and worked in depth with React and Redux or a similar framework. You understand how they work in detail, and can show your team a thing or two.
    • Scale, maintain, and improve. As we continue to grow, you’ll anticipate challenges before they happen by maintaining existing codebases and system infrastructures, as well as enhancing the development, staging and production environments of our applications. 
    • Participate and contribute. You’ll have an active hand in code reviews, as well as in project planning and management. You’ll also provide input for ongoing improvement of engineering practices and procedures. 
    • Passionate mentor. We are firm believers in knowledge sharing and supporting team development. You will coach junior and intermediate developers on programming and infrastructure best practices.

Among them - Integration Assistant for Playtech Open Platform which improves integration experience for content providers. BackOffice as configurational part of Playtech Open Platform. If you’re thinking of joining us there are a few things you should know. We’re looking for the very best people in the world. Whatever your specialty is we’re going to ask you to go above and beyond the bounds of your job. We want team members who are willing to take on enormous challenges and bring energy, knowledge and flexibility to their work. We want passion and excellence.

In return we’ll provide you with exceptional challenges and growth opportunities. You’ll work with a team of similarly exceptional people in a great facility with a strong team environment.

So, before you apply – step back and ask yourself if you’re looking for a job or a mission. We’re on a mission.

About the project

Our application extracts data based on existing models using NLP and ML approaches which we receive from 3rd party APIs and different portals. The team develops both UI and BE sides with cooperation of NLP team from the customer side.



TECHNOLOGY STACK:

Java11, Scala, Spring 5, AWS(S3, SQS), AuroraDB, Dynamo DB, React.js, Kubernetes, Docker



Must have:

·      5+ years of Java development experience

·      Strong skills of core Java, multithreading and closest technologies

·      Experience with Spring 5 or Google Guice

·      Deep knowledge of SDLC and all related flows

·      Experience of team coordination

·      Strong problem-solving and creative thinking skills

·      Excellent verbal and written communication skills

·      B1+ English level

·      ability for business trips





Nice to have:

·      Data Mining

We are looking for a DevOps Engineer who is an outstanding example of software craftsmanship, a person with extremely high business and technical acumen combined with extensive professional agile environment experience.

Our customer’s location services are used by millions of people every day on mobile devices, cars, wearables and on the web.

We are the experts on map compilation that make possible the most comprehensive map in the market. Our work is constantly striving for the best map ever. Join our passionate team and take a unique chance to work on the core technologies of navigation systems for cars.

We are looking for a DevOps Engineer who is an outstanding example of software craftsmanship, a person with extremely high business and technical acumen combined with extensive professional agile environment experience. You will help us in developing automation tools & continuous integration systems within our map compilation and production organization.

Responsibilities:

Develop automation tools & continuous integration systems that are well-crafted & steadily adds business value, as part of a community of professionals
Drive initiatives that contribute in development of an infrastructure that is efficient, re-usable and reliable.
Lead an agile team, share knowledge, do code reviews, pro-active communication
Boost the effectiveness of our team by helping us in optimizing our processes & infrastructure. As a result, map quality will increase and lead time for map production will decrease.
Requirements:
Requirements:

B.Sc. degree or higher in Computer Science or related fields.
5+ years commercial experience as DevOps Engineer
Good communication skills in English both written and spoken
Self- motivated, well-organized, details-oriented and a strong team player
Proven expertise in continuous integration tools i.e. Jenkins (preferred).
• Proven working / administration experience with cloud i.e. Azure (preferred)
• Proficiency in one of the scripting technologies i.e. Python, Ruby, groovy Perl
• Expertise using and administrating version control management tools (e.g. GIT, GIT Gerrit, SVN, Artifactory)
• Database related knowledge expected, SQL, PL/SQL, Oracle 11 & 12
• Infrastructure Management, calculation of proper sizing of infrastructure, planning skills in setting up, ramping down, migration of environments

Summary & Role Information

We are looking for a talented iOS developer to join our team to work on the SAP field service application that is used by thousands of field service engineers to carry out their day to day maintenance and installation tasks of complex machinery. This role allows you to work on features that will support engineers in the field while they install, repair, and maintain various types of machines across numerous industries such as the food process,

energy, and healthcare.

You will be joining a talented team of software developers and quality assurance engineers that work in a dynamic and lean way to deliver regular updates to our iOS application.

Your day to day work will involve

 

● Work on features, bug fixes, and deploy regular updates to our iOS application.

● Collaborate closely with UX and QA teams to ensure the features you work on meet our quality standards.

● Work with a complex code base and help maintain and evolve it over time.

● Troubleshooting issues and delivering solid solutions that meet our high-quality standards.

● Work with cross functional teams to ensure feature parity across our iOS, Android and Windows solutions.

 

Experience / Role Requirements

● Proficient with Swift and Objective C.

● Confident writing clean code that is well structured and covered with unit tested.

● Solid understanding of design patterns.

● Experience working with tools such as Git , Bamboo and JIRA.

● Motivated individual that can work alone or as a part of a team.

Emotion is a Ukrainian technology company located in Kyiv. We deliver Consultancy Services, Software Development Solutions, Managed Services and IT Outsourcing Services to local and global small to large enterprises. Our reputation constantly growing thanks to our experienced engineering team and international know-how blended with local experience.

The Angular Developer will report to the Product Owner and participate in the front-end architectural design processes of our projects.

Qualifications:
·         Our working language is English. Therefore, excellent command of English (written and verbal) is a must
·         Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering or related discipline
·         Knowledge of Angular 2+
·         Experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, RxJS, state management, routing
·         Experience in web technologies such as HTML5, CSS3, CSS frameworks like Bootstrap or alternatives, SASS, LESS, Micro Frontend Architecture
·         Hands-on experience with APIs (OpenAPI or GraphQL)
·         Profound experience with .NET framework/.NET core and/or Spring Framework (Spring MVC, Spring Boot, Spring Data)
·         Good understanding of project management, system/software development lifecycle (SDLC) techniques and various industry standard agile practices (DevOps, Continuous Delivery, Continuous Integration, Scrum, Kanban)
·         Ability to work in international teams
·         No restriction for international travel

Job Description:
·         Participate in the entire application lifecycle, focusing on coding and debugging,
·         Write clean code to Develop and deliver world-class modern digital solutions
·         Manage cutting-edge technologies to improve legacy applications,
·         Collaborate with Mobile and Web frontend developers to integrate and test user-facing elements with server side logic,
·         Gather and address technical and design requirements,
·         Build reusable code and libraries for future use,
·         Assist with the maintenance and support of new as well as existing solution,
·         Liaise with developers, designers and system administrators to identify new features,
·         Follow emerging technologies.

Employment Type:

Full-time

We are looking for a Python Software Engineer who will work with our backend team to develop new features of video service that will allow hundreds of millions of people to create and share personalized video content.

About

Our Client is the #1 face-swap app in the world. It won Вest of 2020 (Google Play), ranked #1 on the US App Store, hit Top Charts in 100+ countries, and now backed by Andreessen Horowitz venture fund.
Snoop Dogg, Miley Cyrus, Britney Spears, Justin Bieber, and probably a bunch of your friends tried Reface. We have a team of 100+ driven folks on board (Kyiv office), including some of the top AI/ML minds. Yay.

Our mission is to create a new type of AI-based personalized content that will help people express their creativity and have fun.

What you should know

— 3+ years of software engineering experience (at least 2+ years with Python)
— At least basic knowledge and interest in ML related concepts (finished Coursera course, or trained ML model just for fun)
— Experience working in a high load / high performance distributed project
— Experience both with async code and with multithreading/multiprocessing
— Hands-on experience with SQL (e.g. PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases (Redis, etc.)
— An open-minded person who is willing to work in a dynamic startup environment

As a plus

— Experience in deploying ML models to production
— Basic experience with ConvNets and PyTorch
— Experience with Google Cloud / AWS infrastructure
— Experience in performance analysis, load testing, and modules/system optimization
— Previous experience in a project that involved images/video processing

At Reface, a Python Software Engineer means that you will

— Deploy new ML models for production
— Optimize performance of python ML related code
— Ensure the stable operation of the existing system

What you get

— Well, you get the startup environment with all its ups and downs. Mostly ups
— You’ll be one of those who create the fast-growing world-known entertainment app. It’s like to live in a „Silicon Valley” tv show, but in real life and in Kyiv
— You can work remotely but we hope to see you in flesh in the office, from time to time. On a social distance, for sure
— You’ll be challenged to create and to be creative. All the time
— You’ll join the team of smart, young, active people, who do their job well. And that’s the best part, we think

Apply, don’t overthink. This is The Job you were looking for.

About Client:
Sonect is fresh, dynamic and passionate about making lives more convenient. As a community-oriented organization with international reach, we strive to be close to our customers and partners wherever they might be. We want to be perceived as reliable and trustworthy — just as one might expect from a true partner. Sonect treats everybody equally — that is just the way we work, now and in the future. Respect, diversity and inclusion are more than just words. They are our guiding principles.

Our business model is results-driven and adaptive. We strive for excellence and use disruption to bring our ideas further and change the way the world interacts with cash. Our people act brave, learn fast from mistakes and have the goal to get better every day. Our promise is straight to the point — Easy Cash, Everywhere.

The future of financial services is digital — we are building a path to this future. Here and now.

That is the vision that is shared by everyone at Sonect. We are a young and dynamic team that works towards this common goal of a connected and digital personal financial future for everyone.

We have built a digital ATM for your smartphone, which enables you to withdraw cash at shops like bars, coffee shops or pharmacies. After we rolled out our service in Switzerland we are now working on establishing a global footprint. Our aim is for you to be able to withdraw cash wherever you are, if it’s at a bar in Zurich or at the beach in Bali.

Join Sonect today if you want to work in a fast-paced environment and are willing to take our digital platform to the next level!

- Bring in new ideas to improve the app and user engagement

- 5+ years of experience as iOS Developer;

- Proficient with Git

Desirable:

** *  We like to play as a team, especially when things get tricky. This is why we’re not only holding on to the awesome people already onboard, but also continue to welcome and search for new team members. Just like all of our other activities, the job interviews, onboardings and bootcamps continue as planned, we’ve simply switched to 100% remote work and moved all our interactions online. What’s more, everyone who joins Spartez these days can work from home until the COVID-19 lockdown is over. Subsequently, all new team members from outside the Gdańsk metropolitan area can take up to two months to relocate. It’s business as usual at Spartez. Join us!**

**If you would like to:**
- Build kickass JS components and user interfaces for world-class products
- Deliver compelling functionalities in performant code
- Invent and prototype new features and interactions that actually do get shipped
- Join a party of UI-savvy experts amidst and solving hard problems with elegant practical code
**... then we are the team you're looking for!**

**What you will be doing?**

As part of our development team based in Gdańsk, Poland, you'll have the opportunity to participate in one of the most exciting, challenging and satisfactory agile software development projects, while collaborating with professionals across the globe. Your scope of activity will include:
- Performing hands-on software development tasks, such as prototyping, feature development, bug fixing, unit testing and writing automated functional tests
- Modernising the underlying implementation of a web application used by millions of people 
- Liaising with product architects and developers on software design, dependencies and code maintainability
- Collaborating with UI designers on design and implementation of interfaces
- Providing time & scope estimates for project tasks, as well as participating in high-level project management activities
- Cultivating a high performance culture and supporting the adoption of best software development practices across the company

**What we expect from you?**

- Extensive hands-on experience and in-depth knowledge of JavaScript (ES6+)
- Passion for and a good understanding of how to build decoupled, performant, testable and maintainable code
- Thorough knowledge of front end technologies such as HTML5, CSS3, CSS preprocessors (LESS), templating technologies (Google Closure Templates, JSX, or similar)
- Experience in building accessible, responsive and secure web applications
- Proficiency in tools for website debugging and cross browser testing
- Excitement for the latest trends in web applications and eagerness to learn more about new languages and frameworks
- Initiative and drive to change and improve the way things are built and done
- Strong background in agile software development methodologies such as Scrum, Kanban, or XP
- Advanced level English, as we use English in our every day communication with team members, some of whom are based in offices in Sydney, Amsterdam and San Francisco

**Preferred skills:**

- Experience with JavaScript frameworks and libraries such as Backbone.js, jQuery, React, etc.
- Know-how with regard to front end tooling such as Webpack, babel, eslint, etc.
- Familiarity with semantic HTML and crafting accessible interfaces
- Background in Java frontend technology (from templating languages to test automation)
- Good debugging skills
- Insight into the Atlassian product suite, specifically Jira and Bitbucket

**Typical experience:**

Senior: 5+ years in a professional front-end centric web development role
Mid: 2 - 5 years in a professional front-end centric web development role

**About the vacancy**

Nortal is on the hunt for a skilled Python Developer to join the project team of our client — the international mining industry giant! The company is re-imagining and digitalizing the mining process, using the latest and most innovative IT technologies, to create sustainable value across an integrated value chain. 

**About our client**

Our client is a global mining company with a world-class portfolio of products that are used by a billion consumers every day. Our client relies on data and cutting-edge data science to enhance their operations. They also use advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence to optimize their processes.

**About the project**

You will work on the development of the unique backend service for storage, search, visualization and processing of petabytes of images. Working with state-of-the-art open-source technologies, our client is providing users with a single place to access satellite images, hyperspectral images, geophysical images and more. They provide robust APIs to other client’s teams, allowing them to search image metadata in our catalog, visualize the images on-the-fly, and efficiently process large volumes of data in parallel. 

**Requirements**

•	5+ years of experience 
•	Skilled in Python: FastAPI / Flask or comparable framework, data engineering: PySpark preferably on Databricks, data intense platforms and architecture, сloud native applications ideally on Azure
•	Expertise in REST API development, consumption, AuthN, AuthZ 
•	Hands-on experience in cloud services 
•	Ready for domestic and international business trips 
•	Good command of English 

**Nice to have **
•	Experience with Cloud native geospatial (e.g. COGs, STAC, Xarray, Dask, Zarr)  
•	Experience with Python Data Science technology (e.g. Numpy)  
•	Geospatial background/experience 


**Your mission**

Working as a Python Developer you will contribute to the development of robust APIs for viewing and accessing image data:
•	Modifying and extending open-source projects as well as developing new APIs from scratch
•	Ensuring clean design, secure authentication and high performance
•	You will work alongside the rest of the team to create cloud infrastructure in Microsoft Azure and deploy these APIs for use by other teams.
•	Working with project technical lead to develop and refine architecture against end-user requirements 
•	Providing documentation and end user support/refinement of ecosystem 
•	Collaborating with other teams where necessary to deliver business value
•	You will monitor, review, and continually improve performance 

**Nortal offers** 

•	Family-like environment and personal attention to each specialist
•	Direct cooperation with European and USA clients and their innovative products
•	Competitive salary and regular reviews
•	The work-life balance you deserve: 24 working days of paid vacations
•	Educational reimbursement, funded language classes, certifications
•	“Benefit Cafe with various categories like sport, leisure, books, fuel, etc.
•	Health care: 10 paid sick leaves, on-demand medical insurance, Covid tests, vaccinations
•	Cozy workplace, commute compensations, and WFH opportunities
•	Exciting events and lovely gifts for your family

We are an international company specializing in developing AI-powered software solutions for businesses that aim to automate and enhance their operations using innovative AI technologies.

Role and Responsibilities of the SEO Specialist in an AI software development company:

SEO Strategy Development: The SEO specialist is responsible for defining and developing the company's search engine optimization strategy that aligns with its business goals and products. He or she must identify relevant keywords and phrases for the company's business and consider search engine algorithms when optimizing content.

Website Analysis: The SEO specialist should analyze the company's website and identify areas of weakness that need improvement to increase its search engine ranking. He or she should also analyze competitors to determine their search engine optimization strategies.

Technical site optimization: The SEO specialist must have knowledge of the technical side of SEO and be able to configure technical aspects of the site, such as loading speed, URL structure, metadata, microdata, and more.

On-page optimization: Additionally, the SEO specialist must work with external resources to increase the site's rating, such as outreach and link building.

Content creation: The SEO specialist must create content that will be optimized for search engines and take into account the interests and needs of the target audience. They must also determine best practices in content writing and optimization for search engines.

Results analysis: The SEO specialist must regularly analyze their work results and track search optimization metrics, such as rankings, traffic, conversions, etc. They must also present their results and recommendations to the AI software development team and other members of the company for decision-making based on this data.

Reporting: Monthly reports in a structured format on results with recommendations and plans for the following month.

Collaboration with other teams: The SEO specialist must work closely with other members of the AI software development team, such as content managers, designers, developers, and others, to harmoniously combine SEO strategies with other aspects of the company's work.

Responsibilities for the current month:

Conduct SEO analysis of competitors in the US market (Ahrefs. SemRush)
Develop SEO strategy
Conduct research on keywords and create a semantic core for the website
Create website structure
Provide recommendations for developers on how to build the website on Node.js
Develop a content plan for the blog with consideration of keywords
Create a task for the copywriter to write a blog article
Work with external resources to increase the website ranking
Evaluate optimization results and adjust the strategy as necessary


The general responsibility of an SEO specialist is to ensure maximum visibility of the website in search engines. This includes conducting an audit of the website for SEO optimization, researching keywords and competitors, and optimizing meta tags, page titles, and descriptions. It is also important to create and optimize content for web pages based on keywords and search engine requirements.


Requirements:

More than 5 years of experience in SEO optimization
Experience with Serpstat, Ahrefs, SemRush, SimilarWeb, SpyFu programs
Technical knowledge of website for SEO optimization, basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, JS, MySQL, WordPress, and other CMS
In-depth understanding of Google algorithms (deep understanding of search engines, ranking principles, and the impact of Google updates)
English Upper-intermediate+ 

We offer:

Competitive pay (base salary + KPI)
Fair, results-oriented KPI system (transparent bonus calculation with clear indicators and potential amounts)
Flexible work schedule, results-focused, Mon. - Fri. (start between 8:00 - 11:00 am and finish between 4:00 - 7:00 pm)
Annual skill assessment (transparent career progression through grading system and Performance Review)
Flexible mentorship system (comfortable onboarding for new employees, easy adaptation period, LMS, mentoring)
Opportunity to be part of a project and influence its development
No bureaucracy and people-oriented management
Access to training courses
International environment and eco-friendly corporate culture
Young, progressive, and super friendly team!


Wanna join our team? Then we're looking forward to your CV and we'll definitely get in touch with you.

About the product

Agora Data, Inc. a provider of technology solutions for the financial services industry has developed groundbreaking and market-disrupting exchange software for the auto finance industry. Agora is a cloud-based marketplace that enables buyers and sellers of auto loans to transact in a direct manner without the need for brokers or intermediaries.
We use ML to analyze billions of dollars of past receivables, and thousands of iterations are run on each loan daily. Learning from the past allows us to project loan values and future performance of an entire portfolio with extreme accuracy!

With the insight this technology can provide, organizations will have the ability to drastically improve efficiency, lower costs, and gain an advantage over competitors.

About the role

We are looking for a highly skilled computer programmer who is comfortable with both front and back-end programming to join our cohesive, highly experienced and quickly growing team.

Full Stack Developers are responsible for developing and designing front-end web architecture, ensuring the responsiveness of applications, and working alongside UI/UX designers for web design features. Full Stack Developers will be required to see out a project from conception to final product, requiring good organizational skills and attention to detail.

~ Staying abreast of the ever-changing technology landscape to identify the best tools and technologies for the problems we’re solving

~ Scrum/Agile development
~ Outstanding organizational and time management skills

~ English lessons

jd:
Mediately is growing and we’re looking for a Ruby backend engineer!

Our free mobile apps for doctors provide them with all relevant drug information and clinical tools to make their daily job easier. They are used by more than 190.000 doctors in 9 countries and they love us (check our reviews below). It all started with an idea by two doctors 8 years ago, then soon became the go-to app for doctors, which saves them time and improves patient care. We are an enthusiastic and growing team of ~70 people from 7 countries, continuing to expand in even more countries and add new features, and we hope you will join us!

This is a senior position, requiring an experienced developer to help us maintain and build upon the backend of our mobile/web apps. We have quite a well developed data-processing pipeline that scrapes many web sources across 9 countries (HTML, but also DOC, PDF, XLS…) and then cleans data, verifies data, raises warnings, merges multiple sources, applies custom fixes and finally builds single-file databases for use in mobile apps. (Before the final build, quality assurance is performed by a separate team.)

You will be joining the backend/ops team of 12 developers and your main tasks will be: 

- maintaining data-processing pipeline and improving its architecture
- building scraping and parsing components for new sources
- improving data quality assurance processes

You need to be very comfortable with relational databases, Linux and the command-line. Experience with web scraping at scale, data processing pipelines and software architectures in general is very desirable.

We offer to hire you full-time with an indefinite contract (“nedoločen čas” in Slovenian law). We do not obsess over formal education, as long as you have the skills we need.

We already have developers working remotely full-time, so we're sure you could fit in well. We use agile development methods as much as is practical, but we’re not zealots. A very short daily meeting is unavoidable, otherwise we will let you work in peace.

If you see yourself helping our user base of over 400.000 medical professionals and over 3 million patients (growing ~90% yearly in the last few years) who currently depend on us for fast, useful and objective drug information, contact us!

jd:
This is a position for a true leader who will expand our customer base by coordinating customer acquisition efforts across targeted industries and verticals. An experienced coach who will manage our sales team and guide them on their path to success.

We know that constant challenges, a team, and professional growth are important to you, and we are ready to give you this, namely:

- freedom. Build workflows the way you see them;
- the company's vision for 17 years, which means the ability to build realistic, daring plans;
- in the future, join the board to influence the business development;
- our partners and clients are E-commerce projects that you know for sure :) with them, you will build long-term relationships, drink coffee and talk about sales in different parts of the world. Or even meet for training in Las Vegas, if you want ;)

**Who are we?**

We are partners of Magento and Shopware, and we do not plan to stop there.
IT Delight was founded in 2012, and we currently have 84 employees. We see how to get to 550 by pursuing a unique margin strategy.
We believe that the key to the success of the company is the professionalism and self-development of each employee. We were able to achieve success and grow from a small startup into an international company thanks to openness, honest communication, trust, mutual support, and care for each other.
To date, our offices are open in Ukraine, the USA, Cyprus, and Germany.
The company's clients are eCommerce from the US, Australia, and the DACH region, including big names in the retail industry.

**What do we do?**

Our mission is to create the best e-commerce solutions. To do this, we gather talented specialists and unite them in our company.
Our core competencies:
- Magento / Magento2 for developing and setting up online stores.
- Development of multi-stores and trading platforms.
- Experience with a giant network of more than 100,000 products.
- Complex business logic.
- Development of progressive web applications (PWA).
- Shopware 6 development and support of online stores.

**What tasks will the Head of Sales face?**

The vacancy opened in order to remove the role of Head of Sales from CEO and give qualitative growth. The team already consists of experienced players and is divided into pairs: lead generators + sales.
Tasks:
Make sales predictable.
Accelerate the movement of the team (now it is 8 people) to major contracts in the planned GPM.
Strengthen and bring the company's presence in the US market (currently, it is 20%, and the goal is 50+%). 
Ensure the growth of the team twice in 2023.
Change ICP (ideal customer profile) to medium-medium+, enterprise light.

**Qualities and experience we are looking for?**

- from 5 years of experience in IT teams sales in outsourcing
- 2+ years of experience in managing a team of sales and leadgens
- roadshow experience
- fluent English, preferably German
- ideal if your experience in an outsourcing company is 500 people or more
- experience in Magento company will be a huge plus

**Work format**

Remote. Mobility is also important, as there will be regular trips to clients (DACH, UK, USA)

**Who is working with us?**

CEO of the company –  Igor Iemelianov.
Also Vlad Dyakonov – co-founder and Oleksii Maltsev – partner of the company.

**Working conditions:**

Is there a trial period, and how long does it last? – 3 months.
What is the work schedule? – Flexible 8-hour working day.
How many vacation and sick days? – 20 working days + paid sick days.
English courses, payment for sports, and vocational training.

**The interview process**

Is there a test task? – Paid test task is possible.
Interview in English? – Yes.
Intro call with a recruiter (45 minutes)
Interview with CEO (1 hour)
Interview with Board Advisor (1 hour)

You will be a part of the Scrum team consisting of developers and testers located in Kyiv. You also expect to interact with colleagues from Copenhagen (Denmark) through communities of practice. We follow the Agile Safe Framework where tests are an integrated part of the development process, and where development and tests are done within two week sprints. 
 
**Key responsibilities**

The role as QA Engineer requires excellent analytical skills and logical thinking ability. You will be involved in all areas of software testing which will include: 
- Analyze, test, maintain and develop financial software product 
- Working with business domain and on continuous basis enhance your skills and knowledge in it 
- Analyze stakeholder requirements 
- Design and execute test cases 
- Perform incident/error management 
- The tasks of the tester are through manual tests to ensure that the functionality implemented corresponds with the stakeholder requirements 
 
**Your qualifications **

- Balance multiple and competing priorities and meet deadlines 
- Be able to work independently as well as a part of a Scrum team 
- Have a great English communication skills, written as well as spoken 
- Be willing to contribute actively in development of the team's skills and activities with a positive attitude and energy 
 
**We offer: **

- Official employment according to the Ukrainian legislation, white market competitive salary, and corporate bonus
- Flexible working hours
- Numerous learning and development opportunities, e.g. courses, conferences, certifications, on-line learning, coaching and mentorship programs etc.
- 28 calendar days annual vacation
- Extra compensation for sports/internet (after probation period)
- High-class health insurance program

**Why join SimCorp? **

At SimCorp we sincerely believe our employees are our greatest asset - and we treat them accordingly. You will experience an organization that welcomes people of all views and backgrounds, and provides countless ways to grow and develop. You will share our pursuit for innovation and knowledge, and your contributions will help shape the future of financial technology. What better place to build a rewarding career?

We accomplish this through an innovative approach to parental controls that uses kids’ desire to access online entertainment to drive their learning. Direct Marketing
Influencer Marketing
Viral Marketing
App Store Organization
Affiliate and Partner Marketing

Perfectly fluent in English (written and spoken)

Strong with technologies (we won’t have to teach you any software)

**About Xyvo Technologies**
Xyvo Technologies is a leading technology firm specialized in the development of online services related to the CS:GO skin economy. Situated in the picturesque North Holland region of the Netherlands, our team is dedicated to creating state-of-the-art solutions that enhance online video gaming experiences. At Xyvo, we value innovation, collaboration, and a passion for gaming. Now, we’re inviting you to join our mission!


**Quest Details**
Xyvo is now on the lookout for a Medior or Senior Frontend Developer - a true wizard of TailwindCSS, Figma and Vue.js. Your mission, should you choose to accept, involves designing, building, and maintaining the user interface magic of our cutting-edge platforms.

**Your Mission**

- Develop and maintain high-level frontend solutions mainly using your TailwindCSS, Figma, Vue.js and Canvas (Three.js/Anime.js etc.) expertise.
- Co-op with our backend team to integrate user-facing elements with client-side wizardry.
- Develop tools and automated workflows to streamline operations and reduce manual efforts.
- Keep up-to-date with emerging technologies and incorporate new features to maximize development efficiency.


**The Hero We’re Looking For**

- At least two years of experience in frontend development, utilizing TailwindCSS, Vue.js and Canvas (Three.js/Anime.js), is required.
- Comprehensive knowledge of the complete web technology stack, such as HTTP, cookies, caching, REST, among others, is essential.
- Excellent English communication skills.
- Experience with code versioning tools, such as Git.
- Ability to work cross-functionally and influence without authority.
- Ideally, previous experience interacting with the virtual item trading on the Steam platform.

**Perks of Joining Xyvo**
Xyvo Technologies isn't just a guild, but a fellowship of gamers. We offer competitive remuneration packages, a flexible work-life balance, and continuous learning. And above all, you'll be part of a guild that's not just about technology, but about leveling up the gaming community.


**Healthy Work-Life Balance** - We acknowledge that you have a life outside of work, and that life always comes first. If it’s too hot to focus, go ahead to the pool, and work in the evening.
**All Ideas Welcome** - We value everyone’s input. If you have a great idea, you’re always free to bring it to the table. And to bring it to life.
**Growth Potential** - We're invested in your development. Share your interests and learning objectives with us and we'll facilitate your growth within Xyvo.


Interested candidates are encouraged to submit their resumes showcasing relevant experience and skills. Communication will be made with shortlisted applicants. The application process will remain open until the role is successfully filled. All applications will be treated confidentially and must be submitted in English or Dutch. Should you have any questions or require further information, do not hesitate to contact us. Let's create a thrilling gaming future together!

Your role will be to act as a leading technical example for the team of developers in an Agile environment and to assist them in the production of quality delivery to the business and service delivery. The challenges and responsibilities will include: 

- Design, document, develop and assist with the delivery of Hybris e-commerce software along with improvements and changes.
- Be responsible for building the solution designs for your development pod, which could include up to twelve e-commerce development teams.
- Maintain links with business and products owners to understand and build out the roadmap for your products and applications.
- Establish relationships with business analysts to help shape the requirements for your teams as well as be responsible for any estimation efforts.
- Empower your teams to strive towards technical standard methodologies, showing a clear depth of technical understanding and leading by example.
be involved in the whole SDLC, being a critical and foundational member of the development and architecture teams.
- Work within an Agile team, supporting the Scrum Master, Developers, and Testers from a design perspective.
- Collaborate closely with an assigned Solutions, Enterprise and Domain Architects, ensuring designs are working to the established architectural guidelines and systems integration requirements.
- Lead all project or product technical issues and risks that are handled appropriately and resolved in a timely manner.
- Engage directly with Project Managers (on and offshore) to provide the structured framework within which the IT solutions should be designed and subsequently delivered.
- Drive forward business solutions by bringing significant depth and breadth of knowledge, expertise, and practical creative design to the development of corporate IT systems.
- Provide rapid and economical pre evaluations and estimates for business ideas to assist in approval decision-making and planning.
- Participate in process flow analysis and process redesign as well as provide support across testing activities.
- Assist in design or code reviews to ensure that assets are acceptable and conform to standards.
- Own the end-to-end technical solution to ensure it is compatible with the strategic technical architecture and perform a technical risk assessment then monitor and control the solution risks throughout the lifecycle of the project.
actively identify trends and recommend changes to improve Hybris system robustness, performance, and usability.
 

**The Team and the Project:**

- Fresh Hybris 20.11 and regular migrations to newer versions
- Significantly customized B2C accelerator
- AWS based cloud solution with a lot of AWS services under the hood
- Our solution is actively growing, so we are mainly focused on new features
- Joint team with our client with 100+ Hybris developers and 1000+ FTE working on the IT solution
- No bureaucracy. We have a very flat structure, so you are welcome to contact any manager directly. You will not be just a picture in messenger
- Highly skilled team with 4+ years of Hybris experience in average

- A deep understanding of cloud solutions with a preference towards AWS, Microservices or distributed computing and containers;
- Validated experience in systems analysis and detailed technical specifications;
- Strong Technical Architect consulting experience gained using Hybris enterprise e-commerce solution, any exposure to WebSphere Commerce or ATG is also advantageous;
- A good level of experience in architecting, estimating costs, and operating solutions across E-Commerce software applications;
- Excellent knowledge and experience in Java 8 or higher (more than 10 years);
- Excellent knowledge and experience with SAP Hybris (more than 4 years)
- Hybris Core is a must
- Hybris CMS
- Experience with various approaches for 3rd party integration with Hybris;
- A passion for enthusiastically identifying trends and technical enablers who will contribute towards a culture of innovation;

**The Company Offers:**

- Full coverage of Hybris & AWS certifications;
- Opportunities to travel to professional conferences;
- Unlimited access to Udemy courses as well as internal training portal;
- We actively support any technical improvements. As an example, we have yearly hackathons for 3 weeks, when each engineer has half of his working hours on his own idea to make the development process better
- Freedom, tools, trust, and support to do the best work of your career;

Rich experience building distributed backend systems at scale.

● CI/CD

- Experience with Windows, Linux
- Superior analytical and troubleshooting skills
- Experience in writing code from design to production
- Upper-intermediate level of English

Description:

We provide the most integrated system for the world’s most successful investment managers, giving you a real-time overview of your entire business in one system.

Founded in 1971, SimCorp has many years of experience in developing state-of-the-art software for top-tier investment managers. We are an independent, publicly traded entity headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, listed on NASDAQ Copenhagen.

Requirements:
- Excellent programming skills: following clean, self-documenting code approaches, a thorough understanding of basic programming principles
- Passionate about learning new business areas and technologies
- Preferably 5+ years of software development experience
- CI/CD Concepts
- Unit Testing
- Strong English (both oral and written)

Preferences:

Teamcity, Jenkins, GitHub, Visual Studio 2012, Powershell Scripting, Azure, Oracle

Responsibilities:
- The Consultant will assist SimCorp with the modernization of the Delivery Platform for SimCorp Dimension. Dimension is a very large system providing investment management capabilities to the world’s largest asset managers and is the flagship product of SimCorp. Dimension has a 2-tier architecture based on a large Oracle database and is currently being rearchitected into 3-tiers to make it fit for cloud deployment at scale. The code of the different applications and subsystems making up Dimension has up to 20+ years of history and is tightly coupled and should be considered a monolith.

What We Offer

Exciting Projects: Come take your place at the forefront of digital transformation! With clients across all industries and sectors, we offer an opportunity to participate in creating market-defining products using the latest technologies.

Collaborative Environment: Expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!

Work-Life Balance: GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible opportunities and options.

Professional Development: Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes certification and technical / soft skill training to help you realize your professional goals.

Excellent Benefits: We provide our consultants with competitive compensation and benefits

Fun Perks: We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports classes, cultural, social and team building activities such as sports competitions and end-of-year corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones and rooftop decks where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table football or darts!

About GlobalLogic

GlobalLogic is a full-lifecycle product development services leader that combines chip-to-cloud software engineering expertise and vertical industry experience to help our customers design, build, and deliver their next-generation products and digital experiences. We expertly integrate design, complex engineering, and agile delivery capabilities to deliver superior business outcomes for global brands in telecom, automotive, healthcare, technology, media and entertainment, manufacturing, and semiconductor industries.

Headquartered in Silicon Valley, GlobalLogic unites over 18,000 designers and engineers across the globe. Analysts like NASSCOM and Zinnov have recognized us for being a top company in our field, and we are consistently nominated as a preferred company by both global HR consulting firms and local boards. By creating an environment that is exciting and flexible, and by fostering growth through ongoing learning and development programs, we empower our consultants to achieve both their professional and personal goals.

At GlobalLogic, we make amazing products — and careers.

**Project description**
Our client operates in different markets with more than 300,000 products, continuously informing its B2B clients (providers) about new products and opportunities through targeted messages through several channels such as emails and calls.
Our client engaged the Grid Dynamics team to develop and evaluate an NBA model that strategically optimizes their channels and communication sequence cadence. At this stage, we are working on models that will be the outcomes of our project. The project aims to develop a targeting algorithm with the following advantages:
Higher response/conversion rates through the strategic optimization of communication sequences
Shorter time to conversion in terms of number of messages or calendar time
Reduced negative outcomes such as unsubscriptions or complaints. 
Of the main goals is to establish stable e2e solution deployment for all markets.  

**Client description**
Our client is an American multinational pharmaceutical company ranked 69th on the 2021 Fortune 500. They develop and produce medicines, vaccines, biological therapies, and animal health products. The company is world-famous for the first smallpox vaccine for commercial use in the U.S. and other blockbuster drugs, including cancer immunotherapy, anti-diabetic medication, and vaccines against chickenpox.

**Details on tech stack**
Mostly AWS stack: S3, ReddShift, Sagemaker, Lambda, Glue, VPC, Event Bridge. Jenkins, terraform, sonarqube

**Requirements to the candidate**
- Senior MLops with 3+ years of experience
- Team leading abilities 
- Proficient in Python.
- Extensive hands on experience on CI/CD: Jenkins, Terraform.
- Hands on experience on AWS: Step Function, Sagemaker, Glue, Lamda, Airflow
- Hands on experience on Software testing and releasing.
- Experience of architecture and git strategy development.
- Good understanding of Machine Learning model development process.
- Experience of People management/TL experience.
- High discipline and good communication skills 

**Current team size**
Full size of planning team is 22 ppl, most part of the team is located in Serbia  Team is planning to grow even more.

**What tasks the candidate will work with?**
Driving MLops team, distributing tasks between team members, planning activities, preparing proposals to the client with architecture improvement, communicating with the stakeholders and release teams on the client's side, deploying code, planning timelines, making builds, testing out step functions, writing glue jobs, monitoring jenkins job, etc.

- Understanding of networking
- Experience with helm, helm file
- Knowledge or experience with Prometheus
- Experience with version control systems Git
- Strong troubleshooting and problem solving skills
- Understanding Agile development methodologies e.g., test driven development, continuous integration, code analysis etc.

- English at intermediate level or higher
- Good communication skills

C++, Telecom, Networking, Virtualization

Responsibilities:
- Responsible for DevOps, CI/CD, Installation, Deployment and Automated Testing of product components
- Creating a Chart, Umbrella chart by helm, helm file
- Maintaining test and development environments
- Providing security fixes for existing applications
- Work on Cloud application development frameworks
- Evaluate new technologies
- Work with the application development teams

What We Offer

Exciting Projects: Come take your place at the forefront of digital transformation! With clients across all industries and sectors, we offer an opportunity to participate in creating market-defining products using the latest technologies.

Collaborative Environment: Expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!

Work-Life Balance: GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible opportunities and options.

Professional Development: Our dedicated Learning Development team regularly organizes certification and technical / soft skill training to help you realize your professional goals.

GlobalLogic is a full-lifecycle product development services leader that combines chip-to-cloud software engineering expertise and vertical industry experience to help our customers design, build, and deliver their next-generation products and digital experiences. At GlobalLogic, we make amazing products — and careers.

Our mission? We don’t have it. What we do possess is knowledge of cutting edge technologies and development principles, professionalism and keen skills as well as common sense, business ethics and sense of humor.

- Experience with JavaScript, NodeJS and TypeScript
- Extensive experience with relational databases
- Good English and communication skills

- Mapping business requirements to programmable features
- Collaborating with a team during development and deployment
- Design, Develop, Test, Implement and Maintain high-volume, low-latency applications for critical systems and delivering high-availability and performance

- Deploying applications using Containers and Docker

- Official employment and paid leave;

- Young and friendly team;
- Various goodies, fruit, sweets and delicious coffee.

There exists a possibility to create multi layered animations by means of uploading, rotating, cropping pictures, adding animated texts to different pic layers, as well as attaching audio and crop it to the existing animation duration. Technology Stack: React.js, Node.js, Express.js, PostgreSQL, Lottie.js, Bodymovin.

Technology Stack: Node.js, TypeScript, MangoPay, Cockroach DB, Kubernetes, Docker, ElasticSearch, Angular 8

**About the Customer:**
The company offers software as a service platform to monitor, troubleshoot, and maintain desktops, servers, and other endpoints for small and medium-sized businesses.

The customer is a very famous company. Amazon is their partner. Customer's people are often visit Amazon conferences as speakers. You will work with a strong team, who has strong culture in terms of process and architecture!

**About the Project:** 
The purpose of the project is to bring new centralized User Management (including Roles, permissions, etc.) and implement new reliable SSO for Customer’s products. SSO should be able to support a large number of the existing and new applications in the Customer’s ecosystem. At the moment there are 2 identity providers - legacy OpenAM (will be retired) and Customer’s SSO (built using IdentityServer v4). Our plan is to switch all products to IdentityServer v4 and implement new features and improvements. Team’s responsibilities are to analyze the current Customer’s SSO (C#, IdentityServer v4), implement/configure integration with other identity providers and implement missing features, including integration with the existing systems. 

**Technologies:** 
Golang, ASP.NET Core, AWS Aurora, Postgres, OpenAM, IdentityServer v4, OAuth2/OIDC/SAML, Docker

**Project Advantages:** 
The successful applicant will have opportunities to make important decisions, pro-actively push their views and solutions to the customer, and work with a team of highly skilled developers.

**Requirements:**
2+ years of development experience
Strong hands-on experience using Go programming language
Good knowledge of Cassandra and Kafka
Good knowledge of Microservices
Experience with the full suite of Go frameworks and tools including:
Dependency management tools such as Godep and Sltr
Go’s templating language
Go’s code generation tools (e.g. Stringer)
Popular Go web frameworks (e.g. Revel)
Router packages (e.g. Gorilla Mux)
Ability to write clean and effective Godoc comments
Nice to Have:
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field
 
**English level:**
Intermediate+ 
 
**Responsibilities:**
Write scalable, robust, testable, efficient, and easily maintainable code
Translate software requirements into stable, working, high-performance software
Play an integral role in architectural and design decisions to build an efficient microservices-distributed architecture
 
**Advantages of Working with Exadel:**
There are plenty of opportunities for advancement at Exadel
You can build your expertise with Exadel Expert Groups, which provide support for existing and potential projects
You can join any community or create your own to communicate with like-minded colleagues
You can  participate in continuing education as a mentor or speaker
You can take part in internal and external meetups as a speaker or listener
You can learn English with the support of native speakers
You can take part in cultural, sport, charity, and entertainment events

Our people are the source of our success and we value collaboration, try to always understand our customers’ business, and strive for the highest standards of excellence. In today’s new market conditions, we continue to support operations for hundreds of clients around the world remotely, with the vast majority of our teams working from home. No matter where you are located, you’ll join a dedicated, diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.

DESCRIPTION
Our client operates the largest truckload freight marketplace in North America. Transportation brokers, motor carriers, news organizations and industry analysts rely on its market trends and data insights. Founded in 1978, it is a diversified technology company and constituent of the S&P 500, Fortune 1000, and Russell 1000 indices.

Currently we are searching for a Systems Architect to join our Engineering team. The project team is responsible for delivering customer solutions on multiple platforms that are responsive, scalable, and of the highest quality. We use the Agile development process, and value employees who foster collaboration between team members.

On this role, you will be expected to have strong background in designing and maintaining scalable enterprise systems deployed to AWS.
RESPONSIBILITIES
Monitor existing processes, infrastructure and services, analyze their effectiveness and create strategies to improve productivity and efficiency:
Carry out associated responsibilities for all services delivered by EPAM
Improve monitoring and telemetry (New Relic, Logz.io, Grafana, AWS)
Manage quality assurance programs:
Establish functional tests in production (e.g. New Relic Synthetics)
Design customer service policies, SLAs and OLAs related to the company's products and services
Manage Product Quality reports
Drive automated performance testing and reporting (Cucumber, TestCafe, WebDriver, ReportPortal)
Manage all technical and operational aspects in day-to-day delivery of products with full development lifecycle:
Drive improvements of operations and CI/CD (Jenkins, Terraform, Ansible, Helm, Flux)
Drive improvements of development, utilizing Atlassian stack (including Service Desk and Bitbucket), Stoplight, Mixpanel, Ambassador, Node.js, Koa, Angular
Manage AWS services, including EKS, MSK, Kinesis, Lambda, Elasticsearch, Aurora, DynamoDB, CloudFront, Snowflake Data Warehouse
Supervise and develop training programs for other team members
REQUIREMENTS
7+ years’ experience in hands-on development of solutions of different nature (web applications, web services, desktop applications, native mobile applications) in AWS Cloud
5+ years’ experience in development of relational and non-relational data storages
3+ years' experience in project management and direct customer communication
Strong system administration background
Profound experience in AWS infrastructure and deep familiarity with its feature set
Deep expertise in configuration management systems (preferably Ansible)
Proficiency in Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery design
Strong experience with Docker containerization
In-depth practical knowledge of Kubernetes
Experience in Terraform
Experience in AWS server-less stack
Familiarity with logs and monitoring systems
Leadership and communications skills:
Proactive approach and leadership in architecture engagement
Experience in customer site assignments
Excellent general communication skills
Ability to communicate information to customer representatives, listen and manage their concerns
Ability to read context and people
Fluent English level
WE OFFER
Innovative solutions delivery to the world’s digital changes
Experience exchange with colleagues all around the world
Opportunities for self-realization
Friendly team and enjoyable working environment
Engineering, corporate and social events
Social package: professional & soft skills trainings, medical & family care programs, sports
English classes with certified English teachers
Flexible working schedule
Business trips to UK, USA and other EPAM locations
Opportunity to relocate to USA, EU or other EPAM locations
Act as SA for different clients with providing SA consultancy

## Ideal Candidate Profile
Highly experienced Systems Architect with over 7 years in designing and developing diverse solutions within the AWS cloud, including web applications, services, and mobile apps. Proven ability to manage all technical and operational aspects of product delivery, driving improvements in CI/CD processes using tools like Jenkins, Terraform, and Kubernetes. Expertise in AWS services such as EKS, MSK, and Aurora, complemented by a strong background in relational and non-relational data stores and customer communication, ensures seamless delivery of scalable and high-quality solutions. Possesses excellent leadership and communication skills with a proactive approach to architecture and customer engagement.

**Requirements  :**
— Seasoned writer with fluent English and at least 3 years’ experience in content creation, writing or content strategy.
— Familiar with principles of content design advocating consistency through all channels.
— Passionate about technology and IT world
— Can quickly write meaningful content in a relatable, conversational tone of voice.
— Team player and amazing listener who is able to ask the right questions to understand the task.
— Able to multi-task and work under tight deadlines.
— Take constructive feedback well.
— Please submit your CV  in English together with your portfolio or writing pieces.  

**Responsibilities  **
**As a Product Writer, you will:  **
— Own every stage of the content cycle, from brainstorming on messaging to delivering perfect copy. 
— Support new product releases by creating clear and concise copy for a variety of formats: labels, infotips, empty states, error messages, controls, product tours, product-generated emails and more. 
— Coordinate the product localization process for our global audience in 2 languages.  

**As a Marketing Writer, you will:  **
— SEO-optimized articles for our blog, guest posts for third-party resources, SMM 
— Contribute to developing the IT content style guide based on our tone and voice. 
— Write clear, inspiring content for marketing campaigns, emails, landing pages, videos, banners, and more. Use best writing practices to create high-performing content. 
— Translate complex technical features into easy-to-understand and engaging content. 
— Collaborate well with Product and Marketing, Designers, and Business Development people to plan content campaigns across multiple media channels. 
— Collaborate with Product and Business Development teams to initiate and manage projects from conception to execution. 
— Assign KPIs and measure the overall performance of content. 
— Juggle multiple projects at once, prioritizing your tasks and delivering under tight deadlines.  

**Selection Stages: **
- CV and Portfolio Review 
- Practical Task
- Technical Interview

Our mission is to facilitate internal and external communication between companies and their customers from anywhere in the world, via web browser and the app and increase their productivity and become more efficient.

To do so, we have an extraordinary Marketing team working to make an impact in one of the fastest-growing markets with a philosophy of trust, driven mindset and a shared vision of excellence.



We are currently looking for a Marketing Coordinator with a strong background in the Unified Communication space who will be responsible for promoting and positioning the Wildix brand in the US market, and manage the existing marketing team’s initiatives. 



Are you this person? 



Job Purpose



The Marketing Coordinator US will be in charge of managing all the marketing activities with two main goals: Demand Generation (generate Marketing Qualified leads) and Partner Development (support Partners with marketing activities and initiatives). This person will work for the US Market, managing all the marketing initiatives together with the existing US marketing team (a Marketing Manager and a Marketing Executive) and will be part of the Wildix Global Marketing Team, made of +30 professionals spread all around the world and will collaborate with Web & Digital, Comms & Copy, Products & Tech Marketing departments.



Key Responsibilities 



Generate, update and keep tracking of MQLs
Monitor KPIs and ROI
Create and manage the Regional Marketing plan (planning, program management and reporting)
Inbound Marketing Campaigns management (digital and marketing automation)
Social Media Marketing
Outbound Marketing Campaigns (both online and offline)
Public relations and Press activity (collaboration with external PR agency)
Webinars and Events management and organization (both online and on site)
Content management (include translation, website updates and blog posts)
Partner’s support (material, training, onboarding)
Strong collaboration with regional Sales team (meeting, support, updates)
Working daily with the global marketing team, giving active feedback on the material, marketing activities and new ideas as well 


Requirements



4 - 6 years of experience as a Marketing professional within the UC industry
Experience in managing B2B Demand Generation campaigns from A to Z
Good knowledge in B2B Marketing & Direct Response Marketing 
Good knowledge of Social Media, Blogging & PR
Good skills in Events & Webinar organization
Experience with CRM (Salesforce experience is a plus) and Marketing Automation 
PC advanced user (MAC, Office Suite, Wordpress, Google suite, email marketing automation tools for example)
Target and number oriented
Experience managing a small team would be relevant but not essential


Soft Skills



Excellent communication skills
Strong analytical skills
Team player with high level of dedication and commitment, both with the Global Marketing Team and the regional team (Sales, Tech)
Quick learner, eager to learn new technologies and products
Proactive and optimistic approach


What we offer


Work in a multinational company 
Working hours adapted to the US timezone (15:00 - 00:00)
Career growth opportunities
Paid vacations and sick leaves 
English courses
Possible remote collaboration
Business trips to the US

**How it works: **
The smart crib comes with an integrated baby monitor that senses
early signs of wakeup, learns from the baby’s sleep patterns and starts rocking along with music to soothe the baby back to sleep.

**Position Summary**
The role primarily involves development of algorithms for the cradle’s
responsive behavior and baby safety detection using data from a multitude of
sensors - 3D Time-of-Flight Camera, RGB camera, microphones and
accelerometer. The candidate will be responsible for building an intelligent
product that is extremely intuitive to use.
**A sample problem statements that you will be working on:**
- The key feature of the cradle is being responsive. The sensors in the
cradle detect for early wakeup signals of the baby - twitch, notch,
increased movement, activity, startle reflex, changes in breath rate.
- The cradle acts on these signals and if it is still sleeping time, rocks the
baby to sleep along with soothing music. Through machine learning,
the cradle creates personalized sleep recipes to help the baby sleep
better.
- The cradle also learns patterns and identifies periods when a baby
needs maximum attention and soothing. Provides related tips to
parents to maintain a healthy sleep schedule.
- Restlessness monitor : Indication of an impending illness or cranky
baby next day if the baby had a restless night.
- Baby growth - Weight measurements from oscillations, length, head
circumference using the 3D camera.

**Key Qualifications**
Strong mathematical background, keen sense of complexity estimation, a
paranoia for writing efficient code.
- Masters in Computer Science or related branches with 2+ years of
experience in industry.
- Very strong linear algebra fundamentals.
- Reasonable DSP skills.
- Experience with supervised as well as unsupervised learning
algorithms.
- Most importantly, the ability to connect the usage scenarios of a system
with it's basic specifications.
- The flexibility to feel at home in a technology start-up with a small team
that demonstrates adaptability to fast changing needs.

**Desirable Qualifications**
- Previous experience in a startup or a fast-growing company a big plus.
- Experience dealing with large data sets
- Good applied statistics skills such as distributions, statistical testing,
regression, etc
- Excellent understanding of machine learning techniques and
algorithms, such as k-NN, Naive Bayes, CART
- Proficient with python, keras, tensorflow
- Experience on ARM platforms
- Activity in open-source projects and community leadership (presence
at conferences, meetups).
- Experience in software engineering and data engineering is a plus
- Ability to quickly prototype ideas / solutions and perform critical
analysis and using creative approaches for solving complex problems.

**What We Offer:**
● Fast professional growth: significant responsibility for your project.
● Opportunity to apply in practice and rapidly grow your knowledge.
● Competitive salary and additional benefits which will grow with the
company.

- 𝐇𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐥𝐲-𝐬𝐤𝐢𝐥𝐥𝐞𝐝 𝐭𝐞𝐚𝐦. We have several independent products and cross-functional autonomous teams with Tech leads. The seniority level of the team is Middle & Senior, so you will get the option to share practical cases and knowledge with experts in the social networking niche.
- 𝐏𝐞𝐫𝐬𝐨𝐧𝐚𝐥 𝐢𝐦𝐩𝐚𝐜𝐭 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐚𝐦𝐛𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐮𝐬 𝐠𝐨𝐚𝐥𝐬. Our products are in top positions in their categories on App Store and Google Play. - 𝐈𝐧𝐯𝐞𝐬𝐭𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐢𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐟𝐮𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐞. The growth of our teammates is boosted with performance-oriented reviews, IDPs, free English classes, reimbursement of professional development courses, constructive feedback, international projects, a corporate library, and knowledge sharing.

𝐇𝐢𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐩𝐫𝐨𝐜𝐞𝐬𝐬:

Securrency is a financial markets infrastructure technology company focused on enhancing capital formation and stimulating global liquidity. Securrency is driving change at the core of financial services via a patent-pending distributed identity and compliance framework and a state-of-the-art infrastructure designed to bridge legacy financial platforms to blockchain networks. One of the industry's most advanced regulatory technology providers, we have developed compliance tools that automate enforcement of the multi-jurisdictional regulatory policy. These tools provide transparency and consistency to strengthen investor confidence and provide regulators with increased oversight of the market activity. Securrency provides software-as-a-service (SaaS) and platform-as-a-service (PaaS) delivery models to offer blockchain-based financial services infrastructure to banks and other financial services providers.



Our proprietary, patent-pending Compliance Aware Token™ technology provides multi-jurisdictional compliance and unprecedented convenience to financial services providers and market participants to facilitate the issuance, trading, and servicing of digital securities and other digital assets. Securrency's technology is blockchain-agnostic, and its compliance and policy-enforcement tools support ledger-to-ledger transactions across multiple blockchains.



We have built a state-of-the-art blockchain-based financial service and compliance platform that will serve as the global rails along which all future value moves in a transparent and interoperable manner. Well, on its way to being a technology unicorn, but while we are growing rapidly, we still retain the spirit and camaraderie of a dynamic start-up.

Suppose you want to become a part of the global team revolutionizing financial services, developing the most sophisticated distributed architecture in the blockchain market, and using cutting-edge technologies to leverage DevOps techniques. In that case, this job is for you. We work with aggressive timelines and follow the highest standards in the world for privacy and security. And most important, we have the fun of building a world-class application with a world-class team.
**Responsibilities**

Hands-on DevOps infrastructure engineering role
You'll be responsible for managing the Securrency SaaS platform on Microsoft Azure. This includes deploying test, development, customer POCs, and dedicated customer environments.
You'll be driving long-term improvement to our SaaS platform: if you find a way for our SaaS platform to be enhanced with automation, observability, or security, drive it to implementation!
You'll be responsible for ensuring the Securrency platform continues to be 100% Infrastructure as Code (IaC). From day one, we've invested in Terraform-based IaC deployment and we don't perform manual changes.
The ability to learn and adapt is highly valued, and you will need the ability to get up to speed quickly.
The role is internally facing. You'll be working closely with our Blockchain and QA team to support requests, resolve issues, and drive long-term platform improvement.
There is no management responsibility in this role.
In the first three months, expect to:

You'll be onboarded to our jungle
You’ll be able to get familiar with the core infrastructure and internal processes
In the first year, expect to:
