We committed to enriching players’ lives with original and memorable gaming experience. We create worlds where people can express themselves, explore and discover new possibilities.

Are you looking to work with enthusiastic experts who are tackling game-changing challenges in entertainment and beyond? At Ubisoft, we offer an open environment where bright ideas are given a chance to shine and everyone is eager to share knowledge.

Challenge accepted?
As a UX Designer, you will be responsible for the entire feature life cycle, from concept/prototype all the way through to release and frequent post-launch updates. You will be also responsible for the development of game systems, controls and interfaces in order to bring the vision of the Producer into a playable experience.

QUALIFICATIONS:
You are a black belt in design processes from ideation to delivery.
You are master with high fidelity prototyping & demonstration skills in leading software Axure, Figma, etc.
You are self-driven designer taking responsibility of producing large, complex systems to our players with maximum player value while collaborating with multidisciplinary stakeholders.
You are a 10xer; overseeing UX/UI flow of multiple systems in detail from ideation, conception, communication, implementation to support creating maximum player value possible.
You are a critical thinker who can create game systems that can answer a targeted audience’s needs while maintaining the balance, quality & design principles of the game.
You are a keen eye in detail maintaining documentation, guidelines and demonstration assets.

REQUIREMENTS:
Experience as designer in the video games industry with at least 2 shipped projects;
An understanding of game flow and scripting, knowledge of prototyping software;
Ability to mentor and transfer knowledge to other designers;
Ability to work independently and produce excellent results despite technical limitations and time constraints;
Experience in working with other professionals in a fast-paced, iterative and agile professional environment;
Good proficiency in English.

**About Our Customer**:
The customer is an American company based in Chicago. It accelerates digital transformation for the insurance and automotive industries with AI, IoT, and workflow solutions.
 
**About Our Project**:
The interfaces team creates an interface layer between the Customer’s products and clients. All of the clients have their own systems that they normally work with, and the Customer’s applications are SaaS applications. The interface team comes in to connect these two systems.
There are two major parts the developers will be working on:
Building the APIs. You will be working with multiple applications and developing their API. The APIs will be exposed to the clients.
Working with development teams of the Customer’s clients and assisting them in integrating the Customer’s APIs into their applications. Making sure that APIs are appropriately mapped and that API integrations are secure. Closely working with the project management team to make sure that we align to the client delivery dates.
It’s development work mixed with client interaction.

 **Requirements**:
1+ years of practical experience in using Java/Java EE
1+ years of experience in development of RESTful web-services
1+ years of practical experience with Hibernate ORM/JDBC/MyBatis/JdbcTemplate/etc.
1+ years of practical experience in RDBMS and SQL-language (MySQL, or Oracle, or Sql Server, or PostgreSQL)
1+ years of practical experience with Spring Framework or/and Spring Boot
Experience with source code management systems: GitHub/Bitbucket/etc.
Experience with build systems: Maven/Gradle
Good knowledge of HTML, XML, XSD, JSON
Experience developing and deploying web applications on servers like Apache Tomcat, WebLogic, JBoss, etc.

**Nice to have**:
Experience working in Cloud Native technologies such as Kubernetes, Docker, and OpenShift
Knowledge in defining clean APIs and interfaces using web-service technologies (REST, SOAP, etc.)
Understanding of Microservice development (Spring Boot, Kubernetes, Docker)
Basic knowledge of Java Script or any of its frameworks
Understanding of CI/CD DevOps process (Jenkins, Bamboo, etc.)
Sound knowledge of AWS technologies

**English level**:
Intermediate

**Team composition**:
10 people in the development team
3 QA Analysts
3 Business Analysts
4 Program managers
 
**Tech stack**:
Java, J2EE, Spring Fmwk, Apigee, Okta, Kafka, OSB, Weblogic, Kubernetes, and Oracle (to name a few)

**2021 major Roadmap and Priorities**:
New integration with lien holders, GAAP insurance providers, and title holders (financial institutions)
Integration with payment providers for different use cases
Integration with multiple insurance carriers and OEMs, including a major US carrier moving to the customer’s solution
Migration of API services from Oracle to Apigee/Okta
Vehicle replacement offers for OEM
Platform upgrade
New APIs and integrations for APD and casualty business

**Responsibilities**: 
Collaborate within an Agile team environment to define, design, develop, and ship new features
Work with the architects to develop new features for the product
Work with other product teams to integrate with their products and the environments in which they may be run
Ensure code is well structured, maintainable, and of high quality
Develop automated tests to ensure product quality
Work with support to help resolve escalated issues and support sales and service engineers
Be a team player who can collaborate with cross-functional teams throughout the design process and easily adapt in a rapidly changing environment

**Why join the team**?
About 120+ of the customer's clients integrate via API. Millions of transactions processed per day
Cross-functional collaboration with different teams in сustomer’s company is part of the job; you'll work with product development, the account team, the implementation team, DevOps/Middleware, and IT operations.

- Can-do attitude and desire to solve problems

**Location - Ukraine**

Our client is a Danish jewellery brand, and one of the most famous jewellery brands in the world. We are building a team to help improve the systems’ reliability and develop great partnerships for years. 

As a DevOps engineer, you’ll be working with product teams on raising maturity of engineering processes and practices for one of the biggest jewellery e-commerce projects in Europe, working closely with Dev teams on maturity assessment and improvements, implementing observability for systems, with focus on IBM Sterling OMS.

And then there's Zoolatech! Just imagine a workplace and a team environment that you never want to leave once you have found it. Sound enticing? Apply to our position today and we can get you there.

**Responsibilities**
- Setting up metric/log based monitoring and alerting.
- Defining SLOs and measuring SLIs, Error budgets of production applications/services.
- Improving operational KPIs like MTTD/MTTR, service availability & reliability.
- Verifying system performance and scalability by participating in performance, load, and stress testing.
- Work with engineering teams to refine deployment and release processes.
- Monitor and stress test systems to collect metrics for tuning and capacity planning.
- Work to automate detection and resolution of recurring issues (problem management)
- Ensure safety, predictability, repeatability, and suitability of all build and deploy processes.

**Skills Required**
- Experience with CI/CD (Azure DevOps Pipelines preferred) on public Cloud platforms.
- Understanding of event streaming (Kafka), Rest APIs.
- Experience with JAVA based systems.
- Experience with APM and on-call pager tools (NewRelic, OpsGenie preferred).
- Comfortable scripting and debugging distributed applications
- Fluent in scalability and root cause analysis exercises (blameless RCA, Postmortems)

**Will be a plus:**
- Knowledge of omni-channel and Order Management Systems (IBM Sterling OMS)
- Experience with incident command/management (ServiceNow), ITSM and ITIL processes.
- Pro-activeness and persistence in driving team’s tasks to completion with stakeholders inside company as well as with 3rd party vendors
- Extreme ownership & knowledge sharing within organisation

You will be splitting your time between PrimeXM, a fintech company offering innovating trading technology to brokerages, as well as a new spin-off company working on easy-to-use accounting software.

**Responsibilities**

You are part of an agile team and develop on digital platforms and with future-oriented technologies. Our environment is project-driven, which gives you the opportunity to work independently in different constellations and teams, to contribute your existing knowledge and skills, to deepen them and to continuously learn new things.

- You translate concepts into wireframes and mockups that lead to an intuitive UX (user experience), for a wide range of devices and interfaces
- You define interaction models, user task flows, user journeys and user interface specifications
- You use a user-centered design approach with a rapid sequence of testing and iteration of your designs. You pay attention to the human-machine interaction (MMI) elements of your designs
- You perform UX audits on existing applications and check them for weaknesses regarding the UX user journeys
- You design UX tests and carry them out on systems & apps
- You are able to contribute to the design of the UI and components you are providing the UX for (assisting our frontend React/JavaScript developers in polishing the UI themes and components developed)

**Requirements**

You are an enthusiastic UX/UI designer and have already gained practical experience in the environment and would now like to co-develop sophisticated applications together with other digital enthusiasts.

- You should have a degree in computer science or comparable training, but career changers are also welcome
- Several years of professional experience in UX or relevant areas
- Extensive experience in using UX design best practices to design solutions
- Experience with tools such as Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Experience, Sketch, Figma, Balsamiq or similar design software
- Good Written and spoken English
- A high degree of self-organization and the ability to work in a team
- Good understanding of basic front-end languages: HTML5, CSS3 is a must SASS/LESS and JavaScript/Typescript is a bonus.

In addition to your technical know-how, you are characterized by social competence. You are able to listen actively and analyze customer requirements in a well-founded manner. You have a convincing manner, enjoy team-oriented work and are open minded.

**What's in it for you**

- Career growth opportunities
- Friendly collaborative teams and an enjoyable working environment
- Professional skills development and training programs
- Variety of knowledge sharing, training and self-development opportunities
- State of the art, cool, centrally located offices with a warm atmosphere which creates really good working conditions

We are Primex Labs, a team of committed professionals with a passion for helping businesses leverage the power of decentralization, web3, artificial intelligence, and other groundbreaking technologies.

Our diverse skill set spans technology, finance, marketing, and more, enabling us to create efficient and reliable products. As our product portfolio expands, so does our team. We're looking for someone who thrives in a communication-centric environment and finds great satisfaction in assisting others.

Requirements
2+ years of experience as a community manager or customer support engineer.
Proficient in writing with literacy, clarity, simplicity, and empathy.
Proactive, attentive, and responsible.
Fast learner with good problem-solving and analytical skills.

English language skills at an upper-intermediate level or higher.

Team management experience.

Our partner's platform offers a comfortable and cost-effective solution that revolutionizes client interaction and collaboration. It enables efficient and secure management of PBC request lists in the cloud, as well as handling AR/AP confirmations from start to finish in compliance with ISA 505 and IDW PS 302.


The application is currently utilized and paid for by approximately 2,000 users and has been developed exclusively by the company, allowing the developer to easily seek and receive feedback.


Our partners are currently seeking a mid+/senior Frontend Engineer to contribute to the development of this valuable product. The company operates with a lean team consisting of Basti (developer), Chris (Product Owner), and a salesperson, facilitating streamlined communication processes.

**About The Team**

Welcome to our partner's friendly and collaborative team composed of 1 Product Owner and 5 Software Engineers. They carry a lot about the friendly and warm-atmosphere environment.

**Responsibilities**

First and foremost, the company has a list of upcoming new features and change requests for its existing application, SBA. In addition to that, there is ongoing work on a new product, PBC, which will complement the existing one. The development of version 1.0 of PBC is currently underway and is scheduled for release within this year. Another noteworthy development is the incorporation of a spin-off from the group company. This new entity focuses on providing compliance software solutions for companies and has already prepared the initial version for release. Joining the company would entail working on these new features and initiatives, with a primary focus on driving their successful implementation.

**Candidate Requirements**

What we are looking for:

Solid experience of writing and testing quality software using core JavaScript
Excellent grasp on at least 1 JavaScript-based framework, ReactJS, Angular or VueJS frameworks
Ideally advanced experience with SvelteJS
Pragmatic experience with 1 backend language or Ruby and Rails framework would be a nice one to have
Some knowledge of industrialized software development tools and practices such as Git, Jira, Confluence, Bamboo, Maven, JUnit, continuous integration.
Additionally, here is the technical stack of development:
Framework: Rails 5
Database: Postgresql
Frontend: Svelte JS, stimulusjs, html/sass.
Backend: RoR, resque, redis.
It's pretty much the default Rails Stack - no surprises or legacy tech here.

**Recruiting Steps:*
CV review
Tech interview with Tech lead on client side
Possible additional interview with CEO

**About Us:**
Ladder Therapeutics is a Y-Combinator-backed company, working at the intersection of machine learning and RNA biology. We are creating an in-silico and in-vitro platform that enables the discovery of small molecule modulators of RNA. We are backed by mission-driven investors Hummingbird Ventures, 50Years, AME Cloud Ventures.

The current toolkit for developing drugs is focused almost entirely on protein targets. The actions of these proteins however are known to be influenced by areas of the genome that do not encode proteins, the non-coding genome, classically termed “junk DNA”. Variation in the non-coding genome, the “dark genome” is associated with many diseases but remains inaccessible by classical drug discovery. 

**The Role:**
We are seeking curious people, with a desire to make a significant impact on the strategy and culture of the company. 

In this role, you will lead the scientific and technical development of the machine learning pipelines at the intersection of RNA biology and chemistry. You will be working closely with the biologists and influencing the experimental design, target selection and progression of biology programs.  

You will be the face of the company, presenting your work to the research community and conferences such as NeurIPS. 

**A bit about you:**
- PhD or equivalent in a quantitative field (e.g., computer science, computational biology, bioinformatics, statistics, or equivalent). 
- Experience with RNA structure datasets and methods is highly desirable
- Knowledge of modern tools for ML such as Tensorflow, Pytorch. 
- Understanding of both emerging and foundational machine learning methods (supervised/unsupervised) such as:  linear/nonlinear methods for regression, classification, and dimensionality reduction, deep learning (CNNs, RNNs, GCN, transformers). Experience with graph-based representations is a plus.
- Experience building research prototypes and developing product-worthy tools from them.
- Track record of collaborative research in machine learning, biology, and related fields.

**Nice to have:**
- Experience in mining features from large data sets
- Experience with MLOps frameworks such as TensorFlow Extended, Kubeflow, MLFlow.
- Experience with end-to-end ownership and engineering practices for AI/ML pipelines.
- Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure).
- Experience with containerization and deployment of machine Learning models.

**What we offer:**
- We offer an opportunity to work at a rapidly growing YC-backed start-up. Your work will have a direct impact on the experiments we run, and direction of the drug discovery programs. You have the ability to propel your career forward with significant responsibility and autonomy. 
- We pride ourselves in an environment that cultivates curiosity, creativity and autonomy, where why, is always the most important question.
- Our stellar SAB Includes industry leaders in Pharma, AI, and RNA Biology. You will work closely with thought leaders in the field and shape the future of RNA drug discovery.

Teramind is seeking a UI/UX designer with a proven track record for a full-time remote position.
Working hours align with your location’s normal business hours.

**Description**
Teramind provides computer monitoring and data loss prevention software to track the behavior of employees and remote users. Our software can identify suspicious activity, detect possible threats, optimize productivity, and ensure regulatory compliance. Built-in remote desktop control (RDP), real-time alerts and logs. Take automated actions such as warning, block, lock-outs and more to keep your business running securely and efficiently.

**Benefits**
- Competitive salary with a focus on a global market.
- Work-from-home opportunities across our global locations with a culture rooted in inclusion and teamwork.
- Flexible Time Off with Global Holiday Schedules to promote work-life balance.
- Ongoing training and development opportunities.

**Requirements**
- **6+ years of commercial experience** in full web portals design.
- **B2B / SaaS / enterprise business applications experience.**
- Strong design foundation in both UI (interaction, visual) and UX (user research, analysis, information architecture, wireframing).
- Intimate knowledge and experience with current design and prototyping tools (Figma + Adobe).
- **Experience working closely with developers and understanding HTML / CSS / JavaScript principles.**
- Able to **understand high-level ideas and transform them into meaningful and visualized information architecture, wireframes, and mockups.**
- Ability to **produce great work in short timeframe** and adapt to the changing priorities of the business.
- A self-starter mindset who is well organized and always looking to improve things.
- Effective written and verbal communication skills.
- **Inspiring portfolio with relevant UI / UX examples.**

**What you will be doing**
- Think holistically about complex systems and understand business goals.
- Learn about customer goals and their behavior using data, conduct interviews and feedback sessions.
- Translate research insights and business goals into features through flows, prototypes, and high-fidelity visuals.
- Come up with elegant solutions to design challenges that satisfy business requirements and technical constraints.
- Use and help improve our design system.
- Partner with engineers and product managers to ensure a high-quality implementation.
- Advocate for design in strategic product decisions.

**Steps**
- Intro Call.
- Competency-based Interview.
- Interview with Head oF Engineering / CEO.

Do you want to join a team of specialists in Microsoft technology?
We are a close-knit team of more than 80 specialists (developers, architects, consultants and analysts).

Together we design cloud solutions, the heart of which is Dynamics 365 with Sales, Marketing and Customer Service modules and Power App Portals.  Doing projects with us you will use a wide range of Azure services and other Business Applications from the Microsoft stable! We always care about the high quality of our solutions and we will expect the same from you as well.
As a team, we join forces not only when working on projects, but also during sports struggles, which are our common passion (Netflix watching marathons counts too ;)).
Are you looking for diversity?
That's great - with us you have the opportunity to work on projects in many industries - finance, telecom, FMCG, banking, automotive, etc.
Interested in developing in the Dynamics environment and the technology around it?
Our developers, will be happy to exchange with you knowledge related to:
Dynamics 365 and Power Platform, Azure services (Service Bus, Functions, Kubernetes, WebApps, API Management, Cosmos DB and many others), .NET Core, Entity Framework/EF Core, Angular, Typescript, Azure DevOps, Docker, Redis.

You join us, we take care of you as best we can
- With the support of Team Leader, you will create your own learning and development plan, tailored to your needs and interests
- We've got your back - you have our financial support for technical training, business training and certifications
- As part of our global partnership, we offer you unlimited access to Microsoft certifications
- And on top of that, we provide you with time to learn - you can take advantage of dedicated training days. Your development is our priority!
- You can work remotely
- You gain a wide range of benefits (medical and dental care, insurance, multicare and more)

The range of tasks we will give you:
- 80% of your working time will be dedicated to designing and building new functionalities, 20% will be meetings, creating documentation and learning (our colleagues from another department are responsible for support and maintenance)🦄
- Participation in large, often international projects
- Delivering solutions on time and with expected quality
- Substantive support of other team members
- Active participation in training to ensure development and updating of knowledge

What we expect:
- Good knowledge of Dynamics 365 (Sales, Customer Service, Marketing - i.e. former CRM :))
- Experience in extending Dynamics 365 with Plugins, creating PCF controls/developing Web Resources, writing scripts to extend the functionality of forms
- Knowledge of .NET Framework (C#) and/or .NET Core platform
- Knowledge of ASP .NET MVC, ASP.Net WebApi, CSS, Typescript;, ORM tools (e.g. Entity Framework)
- Basic knowledge of Azure platform services
- Very good level of English
- Proactive approach to responsibilities and sharing knowledge with the team
- Willingness to develop and think outside the box.

Nice to have:
- Knowledge of Power App Portals, configuring and extending portals
- Experience with Azure DevOps or other CI/CD environment
- Knowledge of design patterns and good programming practices
- Experience developing applications for the Azure platform 
- Ability to create unit and integration tests (especially for the Dynamics 365 platform)

Knowledge of:
- Integration issues, experience in implementation of web services (SOAP, REST)
- Front end technologies: Angular or React
- Microsoft SQL Server and T-SQL, Cosmos DB, MongoDB
- Kubernetes, Docker, KEDA
- Microservices
- DDD

FaQ
- Do we do Unit testing? - Yes 
- Methodology - usually Agile
- Version control system - Git
- Work environment - Azure Devops
We are looking for people with passion, so if you like programming as much as we do, and on top of that, you want to run Runmageddon together, challenge yourself in a "cycling challenge" or you want to share something you like to do yourself, we invite you to contact us ! 😉

**Your responsibilities:**

- Creation and validation of ideas for building data-driven on a company scale
- Development of architecture and selection of technical solutions
- Development and support of the corporate Data Lake
- Development of ETL data pipelines: loading from various sources, cleaning, transformation, enrichment with external data, normalization/denormalization, saving taking into account nuances and limitations, coverage with tests, monitoring, exploitation
- Search and identification of areas for possible improvement of data processing processes
- Coaching and onboarding of development teams that need to use Data Lake

**Preferred qualifications:**

- 7+ years of experience in designing, developing, testing, deploying and supporting Data Lake/Data Warehouse solutions
- Expert knowledge of Python in the context of creating ETL data pipelines
- Expert knowledge of PySpark: transformations, aggregations, window functions, writing and optimizing UDFs
- Experience in data processing performance optimization: SQL tuning, MPP, caching, etc.
- Experience in the practical operation of the Big Data stack: Hadoop, Hive, Kafka, Spark
- Experience in creating architectural solutions on AWS using: EMR, ECS, EKS, S3, Glue, MWAA
- Development experience in Docker/Kubernetes environment
- Ability to communicate with business and convert cases into requirements, architecture and code
- The ability to find both quick solutions for experiments and stable production-ready solutions depending on the circumstances

**Advantages:**

- Knowledge of various programming languages except for Python
- Ability to translate the developed architecture to IaC, knowledge of Terraform/CloudFormation
- Experience working with analytical databases: Vertica, Exasol, Teradata, Redshift, BigQuery, Druid, Clickhouse
- Experience in creating complex analytical systems
- Experience in creating products using machine learning

**We offer:**

**International business career:** work in a large international company that creates a diverse and inclusive environment for professional and personal growth. Strong Raiffeisen community of highly professional and successful teams from different countries.

**Challenging WOW-projects:** involvement into large-scale projects on product development, using modern engineering technologies, unique approach to encouraging customer-driven innovation.

**Comfortable and safe format of work:** flexible work conditions including remote work or hybrid models alternating between in-office hours and remote work. Offices with uninterruptible power supply and bomb shelters are provided to perform duties.

**Professional development:** knowledge sharing with colleagues from abroad, development within the company, upskilling and reskilling opportunities, internal competitions. The possibility of obtaining a T-shaped expertise. Internal and external training programs. Corporate English courses. Soft skills trainings at our corporate L&D academy. Team building activities and involvement into social projects.

**Attractive social package and wellbeing:** 28 days of paid vacation, medical insurance, official employment. Mental and Physical health support: individual psychological sessions and lectures, -free online workouts, yoga.

**Stable income:** competitive salary and bonuses for your efforts and contribution, rewards for participation in the referral program.

**Our team on social media:**

www.facebook.com/raiffeisencareer
www.instagram.com/raiffeisencareer

__________________________________________________________________________________________________

**Що ви будете робити:**

- Створення та валідація ідей для побудови data driven у масштабах компанії
- Розробка архітектури та вибір технічних рішень
- Розробка й підтримка корпоративного Data Lake
- Розробка ETL data pipelines: завантаження з різних джерел, очищення, перетворення, збагачення зовнішніми даними, нормалізація/денормалізація, збереження з урахуванням нюансів і обмежень, покриття тестами, моніторинг, експлуатація
- Пошук та ідентифікація областей можливого покращення процесів обробки даних
- Коучинг та онбординг команд розробників, яким необхідне використання Data Lake.

**Необхідні знання та досвід:**

- 7+ років досвіду проєктування, розроблення, тестування, розгортання й підтримки Data Lake/Data Warehouse рішень
- Експертні знання Python в контексті створення ETL data pipelines
- Експертні знання PySpark: перетворення, агрегації, віконні функції, написання та оптимізація UDF
- Досвід оптимізації продуктивності обробки даних: SQL tuning, MPP, caching, etc.
- Досвід практичної експлуатації Big Data стека: Hadoop, Hive, Kafka, Spark
- Досвід створення архітектурних рішень на AWS із використанням: EMR, ECS, EKS, S3, Glue, MWAA
- Досвід розробки в Docker/Kubernetes оточенні
- Вміння спілкуватися з бізнесом та перетворювати кейси на вимоги, архітектуру та код
- Вміння знаходити і швидкі рішення для експериментів і стабільні production-ready залежно від обставин

- Знання різноманітних мов програмування крім Python

- Досвід роботи з аналітичними базами даних: Vertica, Exasol, Teradata, Redshift, BigQuery, Druid, Clickhouse
- Досвід створення комплексних аналітичних систем
- Досвід створення продуктів із використанням Machine Learning

Project: SaaS-based, data-driven eCommerce platform on AI-powered and fully cloud-native technology. North America market.

# What you’ll be doing

- *Understanding the problem*: what is the current state-of-the-art, and what’s wrong with it? Review the literature, look at the competition, talk to stakeholders - understand the problem.
- *Getting the data*: do we have the data? If not, how do we collect it? How/where should we store it? You’ll work with our data engineers to answer these questions and get the data you need.
- *Explore and Prepare*: despite our best efforts, our data is dirty just like everyone else’s. So yes, there will be some cleansing to do, but through exploration and over time you’ll develop an intuition for what the data can and can’t do, and the best practices for working with it.
- *Analysis and Modeling*: you’ll identify and select features, build and optimize classifiers using machine learning techniques. Expect to also develop custom data models and algorithms to apply to data sets.
- *Test and Deploying*: through testing you’ll make sure your models will work in production, and that the services you build will operate at scale.
- *Evaluating and Iterating*: the models work and they scale, but did they have the intended effect? Why or why not? How do we make it better?
- To do these things, you’ll use **Google Cloud Platform’**s managed data services (like Composer, Dataflow, Dataproc, BigQuery) and modern cloud technologies like Kubernetes to deploy the tools and services you need.

# ***Skills you already have***

- You’re comfortable with freedom and autonomy: you own your work and do what it takes to drive it forward. You can independently learn new technologies, prototype and propose software design and solutions.
- Proficiency in one or more of the following: Python, Go, Java, Scala, SQL, JavaScript.
- Deep understanding of machine learning techniques and algorithms: k-NN, Naive Bayes, SVM, Decision Forests, etc.
- Deep understanding of Deep Learning technique (NLP, Computer Vision) and tools (Tensorflow, PyTorch)
- Familiar with data visualisation tools and libraries, such as D3, Matlibplot, Plotly, Tableau.
- Good applied statistical skills, such as distributions, statistical testing, regression, etc.
- Deep understanding supervised, and un-supervised learning and model explainability

Full Time Remote Position.

• Experience working on test automation development.
• Hands-on experience in embedded systems testing.

• Ability to set up a test environment and implement test protocols using standard open source tools, including authoring and running test scripts.

The full-time workload on a remote basis
Start - ASAP

Join our team and you will get:

Possibility of rapid growth and development
An opportunity to build close relationships with our clients
The ability to delve deeper into working with the clouds

**PROJECT**
We are creating the future of software development. There’s never been a better time to be a Developer – we have access to so much infrastructure and so many services, but the complexity of creating and managing services, microservices, serverless functions, data pipelines has added a massive amount of complexity.

We are building a platform that empowers developers and DevOps Engineers by simplifying and accelerating service development and management.

We are early-stage. You’ll be working with our small and growing team of seasoned developers.  Expect to have lots of impact beyond the product experience and a seat at the table helping us craft the vision of the company. Our humble goal is to ship a product that’s super simple to install, fantastic to use immediately, and highly customizable. Simple and customizable seem deeply at odds with each other, but we think we can pull it off. If you’re up for the challenge of marrying the two, then this is for you.

**REQUIREMENTS**
4 years of commercial experience with JavaScript
Strong understanding of the fundamentals of building software
Expert knowledge of Typescript, Node.js, CSS, and React (TS)
Solid knowledge and proven experience building backend microservices and REST APIs in Node.js
Solid knowledge and proven experience developing Front-end web applications
Expert knowledge and experience working with NoSQL databases
Knowledge and understanding of cloud software architecture
Knowledge and proven experience deploying web applications on a modern containerized environment
Solid coding practices including peer code reviews, Unit Testing / UI automation testing, and a preference for Agile development
Basic understanding of standard development tools such as version control, command line interfaces, project management, etc.
At least Intermediate level of written and spoken English

**RESPONSIBILITIES**
Design separate components, modules, classes, database tables etc.
Code, debug, document, and maintain portions of software, unit and integration testing
Comply with the best engineering practices, the technical standards and the quality criteria set forth on the project
Report status and progress according to the project and Company demands
Spot current deficiencies in the development process, adopted procedures and engineering practices, environment configurations, etc., and suggest improvements

**WHY US**
Diversity of Domains & Businesses
Variety of technology
Health & Legal support
Active professional community
Continuous education and growing
Flexible schedule
Remote work
Outstanding offices (if you choose it)
Sports and community activities

OVERVIEW:
We are looking for technically strong engineer with interest in developing Products together with an experienced Team located in Lviv, Gdansk, Copenhagen and Bucharest.
If you are open to new challenges and would like to apply your knowledge and experience in creating world-class software - we have a great offer for you!
Our products are combined into modular white-label customer loyalty SaaS platform for retailers. We have customers all around the Europe with ambition to capture North America market soon. Therefore, we continuously innovate our solutions and make sure we run them efficiently in order to offer competitive prices.

OUR VALUES:
🔴 Trust - We trust in people, honesty and openness.
⚪ Cooperation - We do better as a team, and it’s more fun to win together.
🔴 Humble professional - We take our work seriously, but not our-selves.
⚪ Accountable - It’s not someone else’s problem.
🔴 Fun - It has to be fun!

RESPONSIBILITIES:
⚪ Work on developing and assessing infrastructure-as-a-code and SDLC automation
🔴 Keep active communication with development teams to reassess current practices and processes
⚪ Participate in architecture discussions, proof-of-concept and testing activities
🔴 Maintain existing infrastructure up-to-date and secure

REQUIREMENTS:
⚪ 2+ years of experience as DevOps Engineer
🔴 At least 1 year of experience with Microsoft Azure (PaaS services)
⚪ Strong communication skills. We value you ability to engage with other teams and helps other projects on they way to DevOps practices
🔴 Advanced infrastructure-as-a-code automation skills: Terraform, Pulumi, Powershell, ARM; Knowing what's wrong and what's right is just, if not more, important than fluency with particular automation tool.
⚪ Hands-on experience with Powershell or any other programming language
🔴 Good written and spoken English level
⚪ Experience with low level optimization and debugging of apps in Kubernetes and in Linux containers
🔴 Experience with configuration and set up of AKS

WOULD BE A PLUS:
⚪ Experience with building highy available multi-tenant platforms in cloud or on bare metal
🔴 Prior experience with web applications development. .Net is preferable
⚪ Experience with creating Kubernetes extensions
🔴 Knowledge of Go

SeeTrue is looking for an experienced software engineer to join our software team which is in charge of all company-wide software-related aspects, spanning from full responsibility of the entire Algorithms’ software stacks’ infrastructure and their environments, and all the way to the production software/application which manages real-time communication, data transportation, data processing and its presentation to the end-customer.
The Individual chosen for this position will have the opportunity to design and develop high-performance and complex solutions, involving computer vision and machine learning (offline and online/real-time), delivering a first-of-a-kind automatic real-time thread-detection application for security scanners.
SeeTrue is an exciting Artificial Intelligence well-funded startup in the heart of Tel Aviv. SeeTrue is leveraging machine learning and computer vision to bring AI to optimize passenger journeys, making security screening accurate, fast and labor free.

**Requirements**
6+ years of experience in OOP/OOD and coding in Python and C++
B.Sc. in Computer Science or Electrical Engineering
Outstanding software engineering skills with a passion for fast development of high-quality software
Good people skills and a great team-player

**Responsibilities**
The job includes carrying out architecture, design, implementation, and maintenance of all software components of the system
Working closely with the Algorithms and QA teams in order to deliver the most valuable features at the highest-quality possible and always on time
Constantly maintain and strive and raise own/team coding skills to allow delivering a production-level solution
Dive into new and exciting technologies and programming languages
Working knowledge with Networking, Linux, SQL\NoSQL DBs, GIT
Experience developing/maintaining soft real-time multithreaded systems

**We offer**
Competitive stable salary
Tax compensation
Long-term employment with 20 working-days paid vacation
Paid sick leaves (10 per year)
Comfortable workplace, office kitchen, and rest area
Modern and comfortable office near the Vystavkovyi center

jd:
The company exists to help clients invent a new future for their marketing through technology and data. Helping clients to build new capabilities to meet the challenges of an ever-changing marketing landscape, we do this by delivering customer-centric, data-driven, profitable experiences. Working at the intersection of marketing technology, data, and user experience, our clients can use such services as Transformation Consultancy, Marketing Science, Data Engineering, Customer Experience, and Marketing technologies. We also develop and maintain our own Marketing Technology solution, which is used by 10,000 businesses worldwide. We work with some of the world’s most customer-focused brands. 

YOUR ROLE
Lead client analysis and work closely with them to shape and deliver their Analytical Roadmap. Play a key role, in conjunction with the wider Marketing Sciences team, to deliver insight and models to facilitate client and account growth. You’ll find actionable insights within complex data and play a hands-on role in the delivery of innovative client work. Reporting to the Data Science Director, you’ll help deliver advanced analytical projects which will drive insight and strategy across our enviable client portfolio. 

Experience with predictive modeling and segmentation is not enough here, we need people who have something a little different about their background. You may have a data engineering edge to your experience and exposure to cloud-based technologies, or maybe you’ve used some special analytical techniques such as geospatial analytics, recommendation engines, marketing attribution.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES
• Understanding clients’ objectives and KPIs.
• Liaising with internal teams, gathering and delivering analysis requirements.
• Hands-on modeling using Python/R or a similar scripting language, to query data and
produce cutting-edge statistical analysis.
• Interpreting data and explaining the results of the analysis to a non-technical audience.
• Writing documents explaining the analysis undertaken to our clients.
• Liaising with Data Strategists to help turn the analysis into actionable insights to aid
marketing campaigns.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE
• Experience in a data science or marketing analytics environment
• A strong programmer in Python or R, or another scripting language
• Previous experience of working with SQL and relational databases
• Involvement in scoping and generating reporting or analysis requirements
• Exposure to Cloud platforms e.g. AWS, Azure, GCP
• Broad knowledge of statistical techniques available

DESIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE
• Experience with Alteryx
• Experience of dashboard software e.g. Tableau/Power BI
• Knowledge of web analytics online tools such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, Salesforce.

OTHER REQUIREMENTS
• A self-starter, able to work on own initiative while contributing within the larger team.
• Ability to lead, manage and deliver projects within tight deadlines
• You should be able to communicate clearly and prepare comprehensive reports.

**About us:** Litera, headquartered in Chicago, IL, is a fast-growing software company and one of the leading legal technology suppliers in the world. Serving over 90% of the world’s largest law firms, our software is used by hundreds of thousands of lawyers every day. We believe professional development, rewards programs, open communication, and transparent leadership all contribute to a unique and open work environment. Our employees are driven, energetic, passionate, and have the ability to make a direct impact on the future of the company.

**The Opportunity:**
As a DevOps Engineer at Litera, you will be implementing build, deployment, and delivery tools for various products.  You will be working with scrum teams to develop webhooks/workflows between various tools and moving parts in the SDLC.  Create and maintain build plans/pipelines to fully automated our CI/CD.  You will have the opportunity to work with industry-leading tools and help shape how software is delivered to our customers.

**About You: **
•	5+ years of experience building, delivering and deploying SaaS/Web/Desktop applications
•	3+ years of experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, Bamboo, Maven, NuGet
•	3+ years of experience with Configuration Management tools like Terraform, Ansible, Chef
•	3+ years of experience working in micro-services architecture with Docker, Kubernetes
•	3+ years of experience with code management and branching
•	3+ years of experience with scripting using Shell, PowerShell, and/or Python
•	Experience with managing Windows and Linux systems On-prem and in Azure/AWS
•	Experience with installer tools such as InstallShield and WiX (bonus)
•	Good understanding of standard networking protocols and components such as HTTP, DNS, TCP/IP, Networking, and load balancing
•	Previous exposure to Agile methodologies and Continuous Delivery SDLC is preferred.
•	Previous experience configuring, implementing, and troubleshooting enterprise applications in a networked environment are preferred
•	Previous experience with relational databases such as MYSQL server, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, ORACLE server, and client-server concepts is preferred
•	Passion to transform desktop application to web-ready utilizing our cloud solutions in Azure and AWS
•	Desire experience working on cross-functional teams

**A Day in the Life: **
•	Automate configuration and management of dev, staging, and production environments
•	Create automated software build/deploy processes
•	Architect next-generation CI/CD processes and pipelines that guarantee faster time to market for the product and positive end-user experience
•	Design, document, implement and maintain automated processes
•	Continually evaluate tools and technologies to improve the overall release process
•	Work in close coordination with development and IT teams to automate the delivery of our products

**Role progression: **
Within 1 month, you will: 
•	Participate in our engineering onboarding process.
•	Meet the DevOps/Scrum teams and department representatives/leads within the company.
•	Learn our business and customers, and where we’re going.
•	Familiarize yourself with our current technology and engineering processes.
Within 3 months, you will:
•	Configure new application and software updates as required for installers, web application, web services, windows services, and scheduled tasks
•	Execute release activities for various environments including production
•	Assist with debugging enterprise application issues to resolve problems in our test and production environments by reviewing errors and program code.
Within 6 months, you will: 
•	Improve and how we build and deliver software
•	Provide guidance to teams on feature implementation
•	Participate in the bi-annual performance review process


**What Sets us Apart?**

•	Have direct contact and work directly with the executive team
•	Work with a team that has a proven track record
•	You’ll be challenged and encouraged to broaden your skills 
•       Many opportunities for monetary awards for those going above & beyond
•       Special rates for local gym memberships
•       A friendly team that will make the onboarding process smoother
•       Company-paid learning, conferences
•       Regular team-building events
•       English classes

- Unix usage experience
- CI tools experience (Jenkins)
- TypeScript
- Know UI testing frameworks (Selenium, etc.)

Languages
English: B1 Intermediate






Ref Number

jd:
As an **MLOps Engineer**, you will play a critical role in bridging the gap between machine learning research prototypes and production deployment. You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining the infrastructure and tools necessary to streamline the deployment, monitoring, and management of machine learning models. Your expertise in machine learning, software engineering, and cloud platforms will be invaluable as we scale our machine learning operations.

**What you will do**
- Transform proof-of-concept scripts into Pipelines with different processing steps.
- Develop and maintain monitoring and alerting systems to ensure the health and performance of deployed models.
- Cross-functional collaboration with research teams and development teams.
- Maintain scalable, robust, and reliable infrastructure for model training, testing, deployment, and monitoring.
- Optimize and enhance model performance, scalability, and reliability in production environments.
- Take responsibility for code testing and quality checking.
- Stay on top of the latest trends in the field of MLOps and cloud platforms.


**Your profile**
- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Biomedical engineering, or a related field.
- Strong programming skills in Python, at least 5 years of practical use.
- Experience with machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or scikit-learn.
- Proficiency of cloud platforms such as AWS SageMaker (preferred), GCP Vertex AI or Azure ML.
- Familiarity with Docker.
- Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git) and CI/CD pipelines.
- Professional English language skills
- Solid knowledge of Linux and Windows operating systems.
- Experience with medical imaging is a plus.

On behalf of our client - a leading information security and privacy company with headquarters in Toronto, Canada (product company) - we are looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE).

Our client is a rapidly growing team of engineers building simple, functional, and most importantly, useful privacy and security products used by millions of people.
Their ambition is to transform the Internet with easy-to-use yet powerful tools that will enable anyone to bypass censorship, access geographically restricted content, and minimize the impact of marketers, criminals, and surveillance. Among the client's flagship software products are proprietary (true!) VPN, a DNS-based Internet content filtering solution, and others.

The systems team is responsible for provisioning, updating, patching, availability, latency, performance, efficiency, monitoring, emergency response, network engineering, and capacity planning.

**What you’ll do:**
– Identify, document and Automate repetitive or critical processes/workflows to lower the workload for the systems team
– Build out critical infrastructure required to complete our ambitious company road-maps
– Design, configure, monitor and maintain both networks, private clouds and internal tools.
– Liaison with data-center providers from around the globe to scale capacity or mitigate production issues

The ultimate goal for SREs is to, as Google puts it, “automate their way out a job.”

**What you’ll need:**
– Excellent organizational skills
– Self-motivation and excitement about working on hard problems
– 5+ years of site reliability engineering experience
– Excellent knowledge of networking concepts, tooling and technology
– BGP (Routing IPv4/V6)
– JunOS, iptables/nftables, VyOS
– Netbox IPAM
– OpenVPN, Strongswan, Wireguard

**Excellent knowledge of linux systems:**
– Ubuntu, Debian
– Netplan, Systemd
– Kernel hardening
– Performance tuning

**Excellent knowledge and experience with:**
– Devops Tooling: Gitlab, HashiCorp Vault, Consul, Serf, Packer, Terraform
– Hypervisors/Containerization: VMWare ESX/vCenter, Docker, Proxmox/KVM
– Monitoring: Prometheus/VictoriaMetrics, AlertManager, Grafana, OpsGenie, PagerDuty
– Observability/Logging: Syslog-ng, Splunk
– DNS: Bind, PowerDNS, Unbound
– Security/Auth: OpenSSL, TLS, SAML/OAuth, Okta
– Databases: Redis/Sentinel, Memcached, MySQL/ProxySQL, MongoDB, ProxySQL
– Load Balancers/Web servers: Nginx, HAProxy
– Development experience in Bash, Python, Golang or Rust
– Good English (written and spoken)

**How the client will help:**
– Goals: Provide clear and concise objectives along with the resources to succeed
– Process: Develop the best internal processes to empower better work, through iteration, measurement and continuous improvement.
– Autonomy: We trust you to be excellent at what you do. We will provide as much support as needed when needed, but no more. You will have autonomy and agency to drive projects forward, and own decisions and outcomes.
– Education: Provide access to resources like books, courses, and deep technical challenges that will keep your skills improving continuously

**The company offers:**
– Work on successful products with a multi-million audience
– Long-term employment with possibilities for professional growth
– Fully remote work
– Flexible schedule
– 10 days of paid vacation
– 6 sick-leaves
– Regular performance reviews
– Strong engaged international team (level Senior+)
– Possibility to influence the product and implement your ideas
– If you are interested in hacking, computer security, data protection - you will learn a lot.
–No bureaucracy

Our development center is situated in **Kharkiv** in Ukraine with +50 employees and our new head of marketing will mainly work from this location, to be part of our company culture and take advantage of the market knowledge rooted in the development business area management placed in ** Kharkiv**. The sales management is situated in Denmark and you will work in close contact with the Danish sales team. 


**Head of Marketing (B2B)**

As responsible for marketing at Ektos you will be a key person in realizing the ambitious growth plans in a well-driven, innovative, and technology-oriented company. You will head the planning and realization of the marketing strategy towards 2025, as well as hands-on realizing the ongoing and already planned activities in ’22.

**Your key responsibilities:**

--- Build our overall marketing presence and company branding
--- Take ownership for the marketing plan for ’22 and onwards, further concretize all activities, necessary resources, timing, budget, and KPI’s
--- Continue our focus on inbound and outbound lead generation using internal and external resources
--- Optimize our online marketing activities via the web (SEO/SEM), e-mail 	newsletter/campaigns, social media, and advertising
---Streamline all sales material online and offline (case stories, fact sheets, 	presentations, etc.)
--- Spearhead market and segment analyses to drive future sales + marketing campaigns
--- Work with our CRM to facilitate high data quality about customers/leads and 	transform those into concrete sales + marketing-activities
--- Ensure a close dialog and coordination with sales on activities and realization of goals and KPI’s defined for sales + marketing


**What you offer:**

--- You have a minimum of +5 years of experience with (international) marketing
--- Proven skills in inbound marketing, customer and lead segmentation/qualification, product marketing, value proposition, etc.
--- A good track record of managing digital channels including lead generation and website-optimization
--- Operational and hands-on experience working across marketing channels like social media, paid advertising, PR, webinars, events, etc.
--- Collaboration with internal teams to ensure high-quality sales material and 	compelling content across channels
--- Skilled user of CMS and CRM systems supporting your daily work sending out newsletter/campaigns, hosting segments and leads for further qualification by marketing and/or sales, etc.


** Who you are:**

--- An entrepreneurial mindset that thrives working in the B2B market
--- A marketing personality equally dedicated to planning and doing, alongside prioritizing quality rather than quantity with carefully selected target groups
--- Strong analytical skills + data-driven mindset to evaluate performance and make adequate operational decisions driven by commercial KPI´s
--- You embrace an open and honest communication style, challenge ideas, and 	demonstrate a collaborative working style
--- **Fluency in English is a must.**


**When do you start?**

We are looking for a candidate to start January 2022 and will invite for interviews from week 47.
If you want to know more about the position, contact (HR). Or simply just send your CV and application to HR. Please write “Head of Marketing” on the subject.

Description
On behalf of Sisense, Ciklum is looking for a Product Owner to join our Kyiv team on a full-time basis.

At Sisense, we are on a mission to empower modern data teams to deliver insights to everyone inside and outside their organizations. We bring “power to the builders” by enabling our customers to answer complex questions with data and drive the best business outcomes possible.

You will be joining the Sisense for product development team. On this team, we add awesome features to the product that empowers BI and Product teams to quickly connect to data sources, then explore and analyze data in a matter of minutes. It is also one of the best teams for understanding our business, as it touches everything from data ingestion and dashboarding through to permissioning, APIs and integrations. Our engineers do full-stack feature development and we foster an environment of rich learning, development and knowledge sharing.

You’ll be working on: As a Product Owner you will be responsible for designing product features and guiding R&D teams through development process on Agile SCRUM methodology.  You will work closely with product managers to understand customer requirements and design future capabilities to meet them.  Product Owner is a direct subordinate to R&D Group Manager.

About Us

We are a radically innovative BI company focused on redefining every aspect of business analytics.
We’re an industry leader with more than 2,000 global customers, including Expedia, Flexport, Nasdaq, GE, Philips & Tinder.
We’ve been recognized as a leading visionary in Gartner’s Magic Quadrant for Analytics and Business Intelligence.
We’re on-boarding rapidly! We have over 750 employees with offices in Kyiv, San Francisco, New York, Tel Aviv, Scottsdale, Melbourne, Tokyo and London.
We believe strongly in a data-driven approach to all that we do. We’re constantly measuring and optimizing everything about the business.
We’ve been recognized by Comparably, Glassdoor and Best Places to Work for our amazing company culture.
Why You Should Join Our Team

We live our values. We care about each other, the technology we create, and the customers we support. We know we’re constantly learning and improving, and look forward to sharing insights and techniques with each other.
We have interesting customers. We support the Red Cross with dashboards about supplies, help a suicide prevention hotline with SQL+Python ML analysis, and enable Tinder to make better matches.
We are our own customer. We’re heavy users of the features we build and have an intuitive understanding of what makes data teams so special and successful.
“You have unlimited questions remaining” is core to our team’s philosophy. We are excited about learning and sharing together, and work hard to make sure that everyone is set up for success.
Responsibilities
Transform Product requirements documents provided by Product Management team into Epics, User Stories and Acceptance Criteria’s
Continuously communicates and executes the Product Management vision, goals and roadmap to the development teams
Participate in requirements preparation, refinement and planning on story and task level
Work with designers to map detailed UX & UI functionality
Own the team backlog and define teams work plan- accountable for stories and delivery plan of development team
Lead backlog grooming to maintain clear content, priorities and estimations
Answer questions from engineering, clarifying requirements
Accept/Reject completed user stories
Coordinate content dependencies with other Product Owners
Communicate product status, both internally and externally
Provide training on your products and conduct demos of developed functionality
Interact with the Documentation team to clearly describe the system features and functionality
Requirements
You’ve already spent 3+ years working as an analyst/PO with a strong focus on feature scoping, prioritization and execution
You have in-depth knowledge of Agile process and principles
You’re able to communicate with developers, QA Engineers and designers
You’re demonstrating strong understanding of customer needs and ability to translate them into technical solution
You’ve dealt with rich user experience products and user-behavior analysis
You have good written and verbal communication skills in English
Desirable
Knowledge or experience in BI and/or Big Data world
Experience in data modelling
Customer facing experience
You have also Bachelor degree of engineering- computer networking, Industrial engineering or MBA with Information technology expertise or similar advantage
Personal skills
You are not afraid going into technical details of the feature
You can demonstrate leadership and cooperation skills and ability to motivate people for a task without being a formal manager
What's in it for you
Variety of knowledge sharing and training opportunities
Unique working environment where you will have a chance to communicate and work directly with clients
Competitive salary
Career and professional growth
Possibility to work for a big, global and successful company
Long-term employment with 20 working-days paid vacation and other social benefits
State of the art, cool, centrally located offices with warm atmosphere, which creates really good working conditions
Ability to improve English communication skills by working in a diverse and distributed team of professionals and meeting with customers

At Sisense, we are on a mission to empower modern data teams to deliver insights to everyone inside and outside their organizations. We bring “power to the builders” by enabling our customers to answer complex questions with data and drive the best business outcomes possible.

You will be joining the Sisense for product development team. On this team, we add awesome features to the product that empowers BI and Product teams to quickly connect to data sources, then explore and analyze data in a matter of minutes. It is also one of the best teams for understanding our business, as it touches everything from data ingestion and dashboarding through to permissioning, APIs and integrations. Our engineers do full-stack feature development and we foster an environment of rich learning, development and knowledge sharing.

You’ll be working on: As a Product Owner you will be responsible for designing product features and guiding R&D teams through development process on Agile SCRUM methodology.  You will work closely with product managers to understand customer requirements and design future capabilities to meet them.  Product Owner is a direct subordinate to R&D Group Manager.

About Us

We are a radically innovative BI company focused on redefining every aspect of business analytics.
We’re an industry leader with more than 2,000 global customers, including Expedia, Flexport, Nasdaq, GE, Philips & Tinder.
We’ve been recognized as a leading visionary in Gartner’s Magic Quadrant for Analytics and Business Intelligence.
We’re on-boarding rapidly! We have over 750 employees with offices in Kyiv, San Francisco, New York, Tel Aviv, Scottsdale, Melbourne, Tokyo and London.
We believe strongly in a data-driven approach to all that we do. We’re constantly measuring and optimizing everything about the business.
We’ve been recognized by Comparably, Glassdoor and Best Places to Work for our amazing company culture.
Why You Should Join Our Team

We live our values. We care about each other, the technology we create, and the customers we support. We know we’re constantly learning and improving, and look forward to sharing insights and techniques with each other.
We have interesting customers. We support the Red Cross with dashboards about supplies, help a suicide prevention hotline with SQL+Python ML analysis, and enable Tinder to make better matches.
We are our own customer. We’re heavy users of the features we build and have an intuitive understanding of what makes data teams so special and successful.
“You have unlimited questions remaining” is core to our team’s philosophy. We are excited about learning and sharing together, and work hard to make sure that everyone is set up for success.
Responsibilities
Transform Product requirements documents provided by Product Management team into Epics, User Stories and Acceptance Criteria’s
Continuously communicates and executes the Product Management vision, goals and roadmap to the development teams
Participate in requirements preparation, refinement and planning on story and task level
Work with designers to map detailed UX & UI functionality
Own the team backlog and define teams work plan- accountable for stories and delivery plan of development team
Lead backlog grooming to maintain clear content, priorities and estimations
Answer questions from engineering, clarifying requirements
Accept/Reject completed user stories
Coordinate content dependencies with other Product Owners
Communicate product status, both internally and externally
Provide training on your products and conduct demos of developed functionality
Interact with the Documentation team to clearly describe the system features and functionality
Requirements
You’ve already spent 3+ years working as an analyst/PO with a strong focus on feature scoping, prioritization and execution
You have in-depth knowledge of Agile process and principles
You’re able to communicate with developers, QA Engineers and designers
You’re demonstrating strong understanding of customer needs and ability to translate them into technical solution
You’ve dealt with rich user experience products and user-behavior analysis
You have good written and verbal communication skills in English
Desirable
Knowledge or experience in BI and/or Big Data world
Experience in data modelling
Customer facing experience
You have also Bachelor degree of engineering- computer networking, Industrial engineering or MBA with Information technology expertise or similar advantage
Personal skills
You are not afraid going into technical details of the feature
You can demonstrate leadership and cooperation skills and ability to motivate people for a task without being a formal manager
What's in it for you
Variety of knowledge sharing and training opportunities
Unique working environment where you will have a chance to communicate and work directly with clients
Competitive salary
Career and professional growth
Possibility to work for a big, global and successful company
Long-term employment with 20 working-days paid vacation and other social benefits
State of the art, cool, centrally located offices with warm atmosphere, which creates really good working conditions
Ability to improve English communication skills by working in a diverse and distributed team of professionals and meeting with customers

## Ideal Candidate Profile
Highly analytical and experienced Product Owner with over 3 years in feature scoping, prioritization, and agile execution, particularly within complex, user-centric product environments. Proven ability to translate customer needs into technical solutions, facilitating clear communication between product management, engineering, QA, and design teams. Expertise in defining and managing product backlogs, ensuring alignment with product vision and roadmap, as well as driving continuous product improvement. Adept at data modeling and user behavior analysis, with a passion for driving innovation and delivering impactful product features.

Teramind is a hybrid, global workforce building the next-generation Insider Risk Management and User Behavior Analytics platform.

Join our team of innovators who are redefining insider risk management through cutting-edge technology. More than 10,000 organizations across the globe use Teramind to mitigate insider threats and protect their sensitive company data with the most robust, enterprise-grade software on the market.

As a global team, Teramind embraces an inclusive and flexible work environment and team culture. We win together, learn from each other and respect each other while delivering best-in-class security solutions.


**About the Role**
We seek a highly creative and experienced Senior Designer with advanced illustration, animation, motion design, and typography skills. The ideal candidate will have a strong portfolio showcasing their expertise in these areas and a proven track record of delivering exceptional visual designs for a range of digital and print media.


**Qualifications**
-Conceptualize, design, and execute high-quality visual assets across a range of digital media, including but not limited to ads, social assets, email assets, and educational collateral.
-Collaborate closely with other marketers and stakeholders to develop -creative aids that align with product messaging & goals.
-Translate complex ideas into visually compelling designs that effectively communicate the intended message.
-Develop and maintain brand guidelines, ensuring all visual designs are consistent with the brand identity and values.
-Stay up-to-date with emerging trends in design, technology, and industry developments to inform and inspire new design ideas and approaches.
-Be able to conceptualize brand features & solutions into creative stories and translate that into clean and crisp storyboards.
-Create 2D/3D models and captivating 2D/3D animations

**Requirements**
-5+ years of experience, with a strong portfolio showcasing advanced skills in illustration, animation, motion design, and typography.
-Expert in Cinema 4D / Blender or Maya 3D and in tracking and compositing in Adobe After Effects.
-Expert skills in Adobe After Effects, Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, Sketch, and Figma.
-Strong attention to detail, with a focus on delivering high-quality work on time and within budget.
-Strong eye for great design, willing to take on new challenges, and eager to continue growing & testing new ideas.

If you are a highly creative, collaborative, and experienced designer who is passionate about illustration, animation, motion design, and typography, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your resume, cover letter, and a link to your portfolio to be considered for this exciting opportunity.

**Benefits**
- This is a remote job. Work from anywhere!
- We’re a global, distributed team looking for the finest talent. We’ve been thriving as a fully-remote team since 2014. To us, remote work means flexibility and having truly diverse, global teams.
- At Teramind, we’re a collaborative, forward-thinking team where new ideas come to life, experience is valued and talent is incubated.
- Competitive compensation.
- Career-growth opportunities.
- Flexible Time Off and Paid Time Off benefits.
- Ongoing training and development opportunities.

**About our recruitment process**
You can expect up to 3 interviews
- Intro-call (30 min)
- Professional interview (1h)
- Final interview (1h)

**All roles require reference and background checks**
Teramind is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, age, religion, color, marital status, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status.

We are Cloud Linux Inc., the maker of the #1 OS for web-hosting providers. We develop our products -- CloudLinux OS, KernelCare, Imunify360, and Imunify Email -- using the most innovative technologies. Our products are used by thousands of companies around the world, including Dell, GoDaddy, IBM, 1&1, Endurance, and many others.

We are looking for a talented data engineer to join our infrastructure team to provide the best data solutions for CloudLinux employees. The position involves work with various data sources and communicating with employees across all business functions to ensure data availability and data flow optimization across the whole company. The position is 100% remote and full-time.

Requirements

Must have:

-3+ years experience in Python with a solid grasp of the pydata stack (NumPy, pandas)
-Experience with Spark or similar framework
-Knowledge of Linux scripting
-2+ years of experience in SQL
-2+ years experience in gathering data from various data sources, the experience of work with big databases

Desired:

-Experience of work with GIT
-Experience with Tableau, Redash, or similar products
-Experience with data analysis/ data science
-Excellent communication skills
-Smart but humble, with a bias for action
-Knowledge of English language (middle)

Responsibilities:

We are looking for a qualified data engineer who will be in charge of:

-Assembling large, complex data sets from different sources, matching, scrubbing & analyzing the data, and producing data feed for top management and other teams (finance, sales & marketing, support, infrastructure, analytics) to support the decision-making process.

-Developing algorithms to help make raw data more useful, onboard new data sources, expand and optimize our data and data pipeline architecture, as well as optimize data flow and collection across teams.

-Helping in redesigning our company’s data architecture to support the data needs of the fast-growing business and allow for greater scalability.

-Work with data analytics to help in developing tools and reports that provide actionable insights into operational efficiency, profitability, customer acquisition, and other key business performance metrics.

What is for you?

-Great opportunity for professional development within a young and fast-growing company
-Interesting and challenging projects
-Remote work with long-term employment on a full-time basis under contract
-Compensation in US dollars
-Flexible working hours
-Paid one month vacation per year and sick leaves
-Days off on national holidays
-Medical insurance
-Coworking compensation
-English Language training
-Tasks with the challenge
-Knowledge **Exchange**

Let’s make it a win-win for you and CloudLinux. Do not put it off until later - apply today and our team will gladly welcome you.

By applying for this position, you agree with Cloudlinux Privacy Policy and give us your consent to maintain and process your personal data in this respect. Please read our Privacy Policy for more information.

Our client is the UK’s leading provider of smart current accounts for sole traders and small companies and also the leading provider of UK SME business accounts and one of the fastest-growing fintech in the UK. Our client's mission is to save business owners time and money on their banking and finance admin so they can get back to doing what they love – for too long, these customers have been under-served by the big banks.

Client's offices are located in London, UK, Sofia, Bulgaria, and Hyderabad, India, where their teams are dedicated to our small business members, revolutionizing business banking for SMEs. 

**Responsibilities:**
- Developing SQL code to interrogate our data to solve key business problems
- Proactively bringing new ideas to the table relating to business questions, analytics approaches, datasets, and ways of working.
- Training business stakeholders of all levels on creating their own dashboards and analytics best practices. 
- Assessing opportunities, understanding behavior, testing hypotheses with data analysis
- Communicating segmentation analysis, relevant trends, and campaign performances to internal as well as external stakeholders and across the business
- Forecasting through Uncertainty/Sensitivity testing and scenario planning to create a data-driven performance from historic and current data
- Presenting insights to stakeholders and senior management, translating analysis into the 'so what?' and identifying possible actions to take as a result
- Presenting data in a clear and easy to comprehend manner, using visualization tools(Looker).

**Requirements:**
- Working with SQL, Snowflake, dbt, Apache Airflow, Python, Fivetran, AWS, git, and Looker
- Strong data visualization skills, including knowledge of self-serve tools like Looker, Tableau, or similar

**Nice to have:**
- You have excellent communication skills and the ability to explain statistical concepts to business users
- You have experience in delivering actionable insight to support decision making in marketing, commercial, product, operational, and/or strategic decisions
- You have experience in taking a business question or problem and turning it into an insight brief
- You have excellent SQL Proficiency 
- You have a good understanding of the business – you quickly identify which metrics are relevant for an area and anticipate which data projects will add value
- You have a track record of delivering insight and actionable recommendations in an analytical role
- You have the ability to effectively form relationships with the business in order to help with the adoption of data-driven decision making 
- You have experience in building models and dashboards to tight timelines and embedding these in operations to inform real-time business decisions,
- You have experience capturing stakeholder requirements across various levels of seniority and functions and building appropriate analytical solutions,
- You’re a self-starter – you take initiative in spotting opportunities and finding ways to solve challenges with data
- You have the ability to deal with ambiguity and competing objectives in a fast-paced environment

**What We Offer:**
Besides such basics as a competitive salary, comfortable and motivating work environment, here at Intellias, we offer:

For your professional growth —
Innovative projects with advanced technologies;
Individual approach to professional and career growth (Personal Development Plan);
Regular educational events with leading industry experts;
Engineering communities
English courses.

For your comfort —
Flexible working hours;
Office/Remote/Hybrid mode of work
Relocation program;

For your health —
4 health packages to choose from — medical insurance, sports, mental health or mix packages;
Annual vitaminization program;
Annual vaccination and ophthalmologist check-up.

For your leisure —
Corporate celebrations and fun activities;
Beauty parlor (offices in Lviv, Kyiv)

• Participate in knowledge capitalization and dissemination of test automation best practices; Mentors developers to ensure effective test automation

• SOAP/REST API development experience
