• Experience with Continuous Integration (CI) and VM labs
• Accuracy and attention to details
• Strong problem-solving abilities and capable of articulating specific technical topics or assignments
• Expert in breaking down problems and estimate time for development and testing activities
•Ability to prioritize work assignments and shift work efforts based on the needs of the department or business goals
• Able to work under minimal supervision and be self-motivated
• Excellent communication skills and the ability to interface with senior leadership with confidence and clarity
• Able to work well with global teams, including time-zone flexibility
• Skilled in mentoring team members
• Self-development skills to keep up to date with fast-changing trends; understanding of the latest trends and their role in a commercial environment

Nice-to-Have Skills:
Experience in the Energy Transmission and Distribution sector
Experience testing desktop and Web applications

English: B2 Upper Intermediate

Requirements
Quality Assurance - 5+ years
C# - 3 years
Test automation - 4 years - will be a plus
DevOps - 2 years - will be a plus
English - Upper Intermediate

Description
Client: Unik System Design is a Danish company with offices in Vejle (HQ), Aalborg, Copenhagen and Warsaw (appr. 240 people)
We have 15 true agile teams, working within and across all our offices. We value knowledge sharing with colleagues highly, which is why we have built Guilds across our teams and locations, where it is possible to geek with tests and set new goals and introduce new workflows.

Project Overview: Unik is offering two software products: “Unik Bolig” an ERP system for the housing/property management industry, and “Advosys” a legal ERP system for lawyers. Both products are marked as leading in Denmark.
Today, Unik Bolig is a product offered in Denmark only. The SaaS based products are constructed with an international ambition and offset from the start. The existing system corresponds to the Danish housing industry and all domain models reflect the Danish structure and ruleset. The system is built on generic international domain models and is design natively in English.
We are totally modernizing our products for both customer segments, preparing it for both Danish and international markets, based on self-service, automation, and partnerships. Technology-wise, the new products are built on a Microsoft Azure HCI SaaS stack.
Our teams are self-governing and are built with all the skills needed to develop the product (front end/backend developers, QA, Product owner and Scrum master). The team size is 5-7 employees at our office in Vejle, Aalborg and Warsaw, working cross-border. We work with Agile/scrum with 14 days sprint length.

Company website: https://www.unik.dk/
Technology: Azure API Management, Azure B2C, Azure Kubernetes Services (AKS), Infrastructure as code, RabbitMQ, Azure DevOps, .NET, Entity framework core, MSSQL, MongoDB, Microservice architecture, Multi-tenant environment, Elastic/Kibana (Logging), Signal R, Angular, PrimeNG (UI framework)
Responsibilities:
Basically, we aim high and care about our products: the quality of our new product must be at the top; thus, quality assurance is an integral part of our practices in all our teams.
Your mission is to put automated QA on our agenda and ensure our products are provided in high quality.
Specifically, in this senior position, your responsibility is to use your skills and experience to
Define how our QA strategy should be in a DevOps context
Lead an example, implement in one of our teams, and inspire and collaborate with other teams to ensure that practices are implemented in all teams
Establish relevant metrics
Establish the test framework to be used from unit- to UI test, both from requirement perspective, but also with hands-on to construct it.
Inspire and train others and ensure knowledge sharing across teams and locations
We emphasize that you as QA engineer understand agile software development.
You are thorough and feel a great responsibility for the product you are testing.
You thrive on putting yourself in the user's place, thinking creatively and think it's fun to challenge the program.
You have a great overview and find it easy to familiarize yourself with new business knowledge.
You believe in the earlier an error is found in the process the better.
You have experience testing complex systems, and this has given you an overview, so you now have the energy to inspire your colleagues as well.

Preply is looking for an experienced professional to join its Data team and handle data aspects related to our product, understanding user behavior and activity. Your objective will not only be to analyze data but also to generate and deliver usable data & insights at various levels of the organization.

**Mission:**
- Provide accurate, deep and thorough data analysis of matters linked to the usage of the product (website, Preply Space for lessons, on desktop, mobile web and app).
- Together with the rest of the Data team, define the main KPI to follow and implement daily/weekly monitoring.
- Initiate deep digging analysis of subjects that will arise from such monitoring.
- Ensure that the right data is tracked accurately and made available within our databases and data warehouse, develop our analytics capabilities.
- Provide deep insights on how our users (students & tutors) understand and drive value from our product, always go deeper.
- Work with the product teams to identify new opportunities for growth.

**Your expected outcomes:**
- Implement dashboards and reports in Tableau to follow all KPI related to product usage.
- Monitor all A/B tests run by the organization
Through regular and ad hoc analysis, provide actionable insights and best practices to product teams and managers.
- Contribute to requirements definition across Product, Analytics and Engineering for a suite of data tools and projects (ML micro-services, visualization tool, new ETL framework, etc.).

**Your competency profile:**
- Degree in Engineering/Statistics /Mathematics.
- 3-4 years of experience as a Data Analyst.
- Strong knowledge of SQL required, Python or R a plus.
- Strong problem solving skills with an emphasis on marketplace equations.
- Experience building sophisticated reports in Tableau, Looker or other BI tools.
- Experience with comprehensive A/B testing frameworks.
- Experience analyzing data from 3rd party providers: Google Analytics, Adwords, Facebook Insights, etc.
- Minimum B2 English level.
**What we offer:**
- An opportunity to join a worldwide educational product and build a global brand in an online tutoring space.
- Personal and professional growth driven by a strong team, supportive world-class investors (including the Booking.com co-founder), and exciting challenges.
- Friendly, open, dynamic and international working environment.
- A team where your opinion is highly valued and appreciated.
- Excellent office location in the city center.
- Flexible working conditions to support your personal needs.
- Robust financial package to live a great life and keep saving.
Good understanding of a variety of data analysis concepts such as conversions, LTV/CAC, ROI, Cohort analysis, Retention framework (Reforge retention framework), etc.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills for coordinating across teams

- Full responsibility over the conversion rate and sales team success. Evaluate sales goals and achieve sales results.
- Strong sales risks identification and escalation; ability to advise and execute risk mitigation plan.
- Sales team full supervision and support. Tight work with the inferior to achieve successful results.

- English - advanced; Other foreign language is a plus.

- Superior skills in emotional intelligence.
- Strong focus on result and prioritization.
- Superior correspondence skills.
- Strong project management and risk management skills.
- Time management and self-organization skills.
- Available for travel.

**We offer:**
- Flexible working format - remote, office-based or flexible
- A competitive salary and good compensation package
- Flexible and personalized career growth
- Professional tools (mentorship program, tech talks and trainings, centers of excellence, and more)
- Active tech communities with regular knowledge sharing
- Education reimbursement

- Healthcare & Sport program
- Medical insurance
- Memorable anniversary presents
- Corporate events and team buildings

About project:
YayPay is building a cutting-edge accounts receivable management software that uses machine learning to help finance teams become revenue heroes. YayPay’s vision to help finance teams perform their most valuable work. We’re a rapidly growing company at the forefront of back-office automation, AI, and machine learning. YayPay is also one of the leaders of the industry in terms of user experience and consumerization of enterprise software.

From the technology perspective, YayPay Platform is a SaaS offering, which integrates with a number of different systems, such as:

— ERP systems to pull accounts receivable data from (e.g. NetSuite, Intacct, Sage X3, etc.)

— CRM systems, like SalesForce to pull and push relevant customer information

— Payment Providers to allow CreditCard and ACH to be made through the platform

— Credit Providers like CreditSafe to pull credit information

The application is currently undergoing the phase of the active new feature development — we are working on building new modules: Reporting / Analytics Module, Credit Module, Cash Application Module.

The application is built on Service-Oriented Architecture, with the use of Kubernetes and technologies around it.

The main technology stack is described below:

**Job Description**
SAP Consultant for SAP CS module is responsible for analyzing customers’ business requirements and tailoring the use of the system to meet those objectives. Identifies and understands end users’ technical SAP requirements. Builds and maintains strong end user relationships as single-point-of-contact for all SAP CS-related matters.

**Qualifications**
•	SME for SAP S/4 Hana CS (Customer Service), to lead, evaluate and optimize current systems and enhancement initiatives for alignment with future growth. Involve in the full systems life cycle and is responsible for designing, testing, implementing, maintaining and supporting of SAP S/4 Hana CS application with other teams. Be proficient in all implementation phases, right from Requirements Gathering and Analysis, to GO-Live/Production implementation.
•	Understanding the functionality of Service orders, Service confirmation, installed base, service parts management, Business Partners, Products, returns and repairs to leverage in SAP S/4 Hana CS, preparing the requirements specifications as required and if necesary developing a prototype to let users get the feel of application.
•	Understand functional requirements and provide the technical design documents. Creating documents based on the templates defined in organization Business Management System following the coding and formatting standards to keep a proper documentation of the enhancements and developments in the client environment.
•	Participate in lifecycle stages of the project like application design, document reviews, testing, UAT support etc. Data exchanging between SAP S/4 Hana CS system using Middleware.
•	Work closely with QA/Business resources to support system and integration testing. To carry out the unit-testing phase for each module in a procedural manner and to document the outcome of each test case. To fix the bugs identified on completion of the unit-testing phase. To enable User Analysis Testing (UAT) and to implement the modifications as suggested by the business analyst.
•	Analyzing Client work request and work with Clients business analysts to diagnose & estimate maintenance requests, prepare the requirements, delegate to offshore team, Collaborate and Coordinate between technical and non-technical people within the project team.

**Job Responsibilities** 

•	Requirement gathering, SAP Configuration, specifying interfaces, and data migration.
•	Customer and Business Partner management
•	Service Order and Confirmation processing
•	Experience in integration with other SAP modules
•	Experience in third-party Integration with SAP Service and maintenance orders

**Technologies**
•	Must be proficient in SAP S/4 Hana CS (customer service) SAP modules
•	Must be proficient in the following business processes: Field service project planning, creation, costing, revenue, billing, monitoring, repair project planning
•	Work with on-site team members, onsite key users and managers, to ensure that the tasks are delivered on time with customer expectation
•	Must have delivered multiple full cycle rollouts with hands-on expertise in configuring SAP systems

**Working conditions**
•	Flexible work schedule
•	Office or remote or mixed types of work are welcome
•	Regular compensation package reviews
•	20 working days paid vacation leave, 15 working days of paid sick leaves and 5 “day offs”
•	Medical Insurance program for employee (and the ability for an employee to insure family members at a corporate rate)
•	Certification coverage & support for participation in specialized events (webinars, conferences, trainings etc.)
•	Regular team-buildings inside team projects, as well as summer and winter corporate parties for the entire company

**Join, it will be interesting!**

> RESPONSIBILITIES 
We’re open to training and mentoring the right candidate, so please don’t worry if you haven’t been asked to do some of the things on this list before.

— Plan, implement and improve our company’s human resources program, such as our hiring process, onboarding, offboarding, team coordination, benefits, and more
— Create and update job descriptions and job posts for all of our positions
— Share job posts via different channels and find new ways to attract qualified candidates
— Assess potential candidates according to our company’s values and needs
— Conduct interviews with potential candidates
— Develop our interview test and test the potential candidates
— Onboard new employees and help prepare them to succeed at Flowium
— Schedule and conduct job evaluations and recommend pay revisions
— Schedule and help prepare our full-team monthly meetings
— Implement our employee benefits program

> Here's how your week will look like:
— Recruitment and Hiring - 50%
— Talent management - 40%
— Reports / Admin  - 10% 

> REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE 
— Responsibility & Accountability
As our HR manager, you’ll represent Flowium when you communicate with applicants interested in working with us. You will be the face of our company, so professionalism, a sense of responsibility and strong attention to detail are essential.

— Initiative & Ambition
We want to work with people who are passionate, energetic and dedicated to what they do. We’ll go out of our way to give you everything you need to succeed, but we also expect you to be an independent self-starter who takes the initiative to help us improve.

— Passion for HR management 
﻿Are you the kind of person who could help start a great friendship between people who didn’t know each other before? As an HR manager at Flowium, you should have a perfect understanding of our values and needs and an appetite to look for perfect matches while recruiting for us.

— Communication Skills
You should have a passion and knack for communicating with people. Your role will primarily consist of hiring applicants and communicating with our team on a daily basis. You should be well-organized, accustomed to keeping records of all your conversations, and able to find the best communication channels to use with different people.

> NEXT STEPS
1. Application Form
Fill out the application on our site (don’t worry, it’s pretty painless) (up to 30 mins)
2. Application Form Review 
We’ll take a look at your submission and get in touch within 14 days to schedule an interview if we feel like you’d fit in at Flowium
3. Interview 
Basic interview with founder Andriy Boychuk via Zoom (up to 30 mins)
4. Offer
If all goes well, we’ll offer you the job and begin onboarding!

Give you access to experienced specialists willing to share their knowledge

**Project / Company:** One Right Eye / Centre for Eye Research Australia (CERA)

**Timeline:**
Aim to fill this position by mid August 2023 with project kickoff shortly after.
Future ongoing work available.

**About the Company:**
One Right Eye is at the forefront of medical education technology, pioneering digital tools that enhance patient comprehension and improve clinical consultations. Our innovative product, a 3D model of the human eye, is in beta testing and has proven indispensable for optometrists explaining complex scan results to patients. To extend its impact and efficiency, we're seeking a skilled Unity Developer to join our creative team.

**About the Team:**
Our team currently consists of a two specialist eye surgeons, a 3D graphic artist, a UI/UX designer, a unity developer and a technical artist.

**About the Project:**
Patients typically undergo several scans during optometry visits. Making sense of these scans can be daunting, and our 3D model eye is a crucial tool in contextualizing this information. As a Unity Developer, you will play a vital role in the development of three interactive educational modules focusing on key scans: the Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT), Fundus photography, and Humphry visual field. Your work will enable optometrists to better explain these scans, improving patient understanding and facilitating better doctor-patient communication.

**Responsibilities:**
Implement UI/UX designs in Unity.
Implement animations designed by the graphics team.
Implement new art assets and ensure their compatibility with the Unity platform.
Contribute creatively to the design of the educational modules.
Perform thorough testing to ensure functionality and resolve issues.
Collaborate effectively with the graphics artist and UI/UX designer.

**Skills Required:**
Proficiency in Unity development.
Experience importing 3D art from various platforms and ensuring visual fidelity.
Solid understanding of shaders and rendering issues, with the ability to troubleshoot to ensure photorealistic representation.
Ability to work flexibly and collaboratively with artists and UI/UX designers.

**Deliverables:**
Implement three educational modules centered on specific eye scans in Unity.

**How to apply:**
Please send your expression of interest with your up to date resume. If this project is interesting to you but you’re not yet ready to apply, we’d be very happy to answer any clarifying questions you might have.

• Ability to write documented, optimal and reliable code.
• A strong understanding of how distributed systems work and, more importantly, fail.

• Ability to get out of the comfort zone and explore areas beyond the existing skillset.
• Strong understanding and experience with SQL, specifically PostgreSQL.
Initiative and motivation to make things happen.

Daxx offers:
• Direct cooperation with the customer
• Dedicated HR / Client Manager
• Regular performance reviews
• Competitive salary, medical insurance, 20 working vacation days
• Regular corporate events, team buildings, etc.

Multiyear winner of the prestigious Best in KLAS award for Long-Term Care Software, MatrixCare is the complete solution for growing organizations that need to successfully manage risk in care delivery across the LTPAC spectrum. 

Trusted by more than 13,000 facility-based care settings and more than 2,500 home care, home health and hospice organizations, MatrixCare’s solutions help ACOs, skilled nursing and senior living providers, life plan communities, and home health organizations to connect, collaborate and prosper as we migrate to a fee-for-value healthcare system.
 
MatrixCare provides integrated business management solutions. The Company offers software solution for billing, inventory management, A/R management, point of sale, marketing management, scheduling, and reporting tools.
It’s a proven platform that can make work better, faster, and more rewarding—from day one. For the HME, pharmacy, home health, hospice, and private duty software solutions.

We are going to engage with the Client to extend their line of the mobile applications. The functional capabilities of their solution include electronic health record/electronic medical record (EHR/EMR) apps that enable Home Care organizations to enforce best practices that maximize compliance, improve client outcomes and increase efficiencies. It’s designed to enable Caregivers to have the ability to document services at the point-of-care to ensure accuracy and compliance, without compromising the care of the client. It allows Users to access their schedules and client information at the time the care is provided. 

We plan to start the balanced development team who will work on the backlog of tasks provided by the client.

The technical stack is expected to be Xamarin.Forms + .NET (.NET Framework,.NET Core, SQL, MVP, Entity).

**8allocate** is an IT outsourcing company with headquarters in Estonia and R&D offices in Ukraine and Poland. We provide custom software development services for clients from the UK and the USA, specializing in FinTech and EdTech. We are seeking a highly skilled and creative UX/UI Designer to join our team for presale activities. As a UX/UI Designer, you will play a crucial role in fast-tracking the creation of a compelling Minimum Viable Product (MVP) that will attract potential clients and lead to signed proposals. This is an exciting opportunity to showcase your design expertise and contribute to the success of our projects.

This is a **part-time position**, allowing you to contribute your skills and creativity flexibly while collaborating with our dynamic team on **presale activities**. As a UX/UI Designer, you will have a significant impact on our client acquisition process and contribute to the success of our proposals.

**Requirements:**
— Experience: Proven experience in UX/UI design, specifically in creating MVPs or prototypes for presale activities.
— Portfolio: A strong portfolio showcasing your design projects, with a focus on MVP designs, user interfaces, and user experiences.
— Tools: Proficiency in design tools such as Adobe Creative Suite (e.g., Adobe XD, Photoshop, Illustrator) and other prototyping tools (Figma, Miro, etc).
— Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to understand complex requirements and transform them into innovative and user-friendly designs.
— User-Centric Approach: Strong understanding of user-centered design principles and practices, with a keen eye for user behavior and interaction patterns.
— Communication Skills: Excellent communication and presentation skills to effectively convey design concepts and ideas to both internal teams and potential clients.
— Time Management: Capability to handle tight deadlines and fast-paced environments while maintaining a high level of design quality.
Innovation and Creativity: A passion for design innovation and the ability to think outside the box to create impactful MVPs.

**Role and Responsibilities:**
As a UX/UI Designer focusing on presale activities, your responsibilities will include:
— Rapid MVP Design: Collaborate with the sales and product teams to quickly conceptualize, design, and prototype MVPs that align with potential clients' needs and preferences.
— User Research: Conduct user research and gather insights to inform design decisions and ensure the MVP addresses the pain points and requirements of the target audience.
— Wireframing and Prototyping: Create wireframes and interactive prototypes to demonstrate the functionality and user experience of the MVP.
— Visual Design: Develop visually appealing and intuitive user interfaces, ensuring a consistent and seamless design language.
— Presentation: Articulate design concepts and present MVPs to potential clients during presale meetings and workshops.
— Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including developers, product managers, and sales representatives, to align on design strategies and iterate on the MVP as necessary.
— Design Guidelines: Establish and maintain design guidelines and best practices to ensure consistency and efficiency in the presale design process.

**Why choose us?**
— “Family and Friends”. We are no longer a start-up, but we still, have a family atmosphere in our supportive and spirited team, who are all working together on the same goal.
— “Just break down all barriers and find a better way”. Every day you’ll meet with interesting and challenging (international) projects that are covering industries from commercial aviation to fintech (different technologies, different products).
— “Hungry for learning”. You will get a lot of chances for career advancement and the development of new skills, opportunities for mentorship, or learning from more experienced colleagues.

Brainstack_ is a fast-growing product company that develops high-tech solutions for customers in more than 100 countries. Armed with the latest technologies and a young ambitious team, we strive to be the best in what we do. We strongly believe that the personal growth and self-development of every team member is one of the pillars of a successful business strategy. That’s why we are ready to provide all the tools and support necessary for your professional journey.

Here, there’s no room for bureaucracy or micromanagement — each team can create its own ecosystem that’ll ensure max productivity and perfect teamwork.

Brainstack_ is seeking an experienced and motivated Data Analyst to organize our analytics function, and set the strategy and drive the vision for the Analytics department across the whole business.

As a Data Analyst, you will be shaping the future of the Company and working directly with Heads of departments (Development, Billing, Marketing, Customer Care, etc.).

Your main goal will be to help our business use data to drive high performance and quality.

Responsibilities:

— Business Intelligent development (Creation of an automated reporting In Tableau, work with Data Engineers to design DWH scheme and ETL processes).
— Data Analysis to identify the causes of deviations in business metrics, as well as optimization of activities.
— Evaluation of experimental results (A/B tests).
— Billing logic optimization: AR, decline reason analysis, refunds and chargebacks forecasting.
— Forecasting the financial results.
— Participation in business optimization projects.


Required skills:

— Technical or Economics Degree.
— 2+ years of professional experience in an analytical role.
— Good theoretical background in statistic, hypothesis testing and familiar with multivariate regression analysis (Logistic Regression, etc.)
— Good Knowledge of Python/R, SQL (MySQL, PostgreSQL).
— Experience with data warehousing and visualization tools (Tableau / Power BI).
— Web analytics knowledge, experience with Google Analytics is a plus.
— Excel at a high level (pivot tables, connection to external sources).
— Analytical thinking, ability to find patterns in studied data sets, reasons for the deviations of indicators that describe business processes, briefly and accurately focus on the main causes of deviations.
— Intermediate English level or higher.

Would be a plus:
— Good understanding of digital marketing, understanding of online business, knowledge of its main specific indicators.
— Experience in predictive analytics (time-series analysis and forecasting, survival analysis, etc.).
— Experience with cloud computing services (GCP, etc.).

Soft skills:

— Problem Solving
— Aptitude for teamwork
— Curious
— Flexible
— Thinking outside the box
— Creativity
— Decision Making
— Proactive
— Adaptability
— Result-driven

We offer:

— Possibility to be part of the creative environment and make your input to it.
— Variety of social and professional activities.
— Friendly and warm culture.
— PE employment.
— 24 calendar days of vacation paid per year.
— Medical insurance.
— Documented sick days paid.
— 3 non-documented sick days paid.
— Breakfasts/fruit/yummies in the kitchen.

Our apps have a lot of potential for growth. We're managing another business of ours and we don't have so much time for the apps. Once again, if you want to make good money and be almost our business partner, go ahead and apply!

**Company information**

We use generative adversarial networks (GANs) and other bleeding-edge techniques from deep learning to synthesize photos and videos of
people. Creative and marketing teams use Rosebud to replace models and photoshoots. We already have 4000 people using our AI synthesized
stock photos that offer a diverse array of models.

We're democratizing the creation of visuals so that brands big and small can tell their story compellingly. We believe all image and video creation
will be done via generative methods in 5 years. We're building that future.

We are backed by YCombinator, Khosla Ventures, Amplify Partners and Lux Capital. With participation from Ilya Sutskever (cofounder/chief
scientist Open AI) and Kevin Lin (cofounder COO Twitch).

We launched 25,000 AI-generated photos last November, which became a finalist in the Design category for Product Hunt’s 2019 Golden Kitty
Awards. We’ve been covered by the Washington post and have over 4000 users sign up and tens of thousands of downloads of our generated
images on app.generative.photos.

**Job description**

Build the future of content creation with us. You get to work on implementing bleeding-edge research for generating videos and images and scale
them to production.
We support a growth mindset, perks include conference travel and paper publications and mentorship from top researchers in the field.
This is a remote position with an opportunity for relocation to SF in the future.

— Working hours should overlap at least 4 hours with PST (6 pm - 10 pm Kyiv time).

**Responsibilities and what we are looking for**

— If you have a lot of computers vision experience, but not in particular with GANs, you should have implemented papers yourself, especially in
GAN-type architectures (e.g. StyleGAN/ CycleGAN), and have done end-to-end deployments there. We have a lot of features we want to
implement and they're pretty finicky to train, so we're really prioritizing the people who have worked with these architectures, debugged them, and
scaled up experimentation.
— Training and deploying large-scale Deep Learning models on cloud infrastructure. We use AWS and GCP.

— You are a strong individual contributor, with a low ego and high intellectual curiosity;

— We are a tiny team with complementary skill sets, driven by being on top of the bleeding-edge technology.
— You are excited about implementing your own ideas and making them work;

— We value independence and proactivity.
— You don’t need much direction and keep documentation well-organized.

— We are sticking to an open office’ concept, so every member of the team can see where you’re at and vise versa.

— Familiarity with GANs (eg. StyleGAN, conditional GANs, image2image translations, vid2vid), Autoregressive models, Flow models is a huge plus.
We use Tensorflow and Pytorch.

— You are excellent at debugging deep learning models and are an expert at implementing models from scratch, using cloud infrastructure to
train and deploy these models.

Hello, all!
On behalf of Wand AI (ex. Wayto), SD Solutions is looking for **ML Engineer** who wants to break boundaries, move mountains, and shape the future of AI. Wand AI mission is to make business-centric AI easy to use, safe, and accessible to everyone. 
Our platform enables business users to build and run AI applications safety, quickly, and efficiently - allcodeless, self-serviced. 

We are looking for passionate, ambitious, and excellent engineers! Wand AI engineers are Kubernetes experts, develop cutting edge technologies and strive to get the best user experience and efficiency for our customers.

**What will you do with us?**

- Own, design, and develop Wand AI ML pipelines: provide efficient models training, testing, deployment, and monitoring.
- Apply your scientific knowledge to analyze and collect data, identify problems, devise solutions and construct methodologies.
- Develop machine learning and deep learning models for tabular data (later: time series, NLP, CV, etc.).
- Learn and implement cutting-edge ML algorithms.
- Create and automate data pipelines including data extraction, validation & anomaly detection, indexing, and other data-related tasks.
- Follow your project from ideation to implementation.
- Contribute to a wide variety of projects using a range of technologies and tools.

**What hard skills do we need?**

- **5+ years of industrial experience** with ML, including **training**, **testing**, **deployment**, and **monitoring** real-time (or near real-time) machine learning models **in production**.
- Proven experience with **modern DL** techniques and **Gradient Boosting Trees**.
- Experience with ML “understanding” techniques: **explainability**, **confidence**, **drift**, etc.
- **Excellent Python** coding skills.
- **Proficiency with ML libraries** (Tensorflow, Pytorch, LightGBM, Scikit-learn).
- Vast practical experience with **tabular data** and time series.
- Experience in Microservices architecture, cloud technologies, Docker, Kubernetes.

**Advantages:** 

- **M.Sc.** in computer science with a thesis in **ML**. **PhD.**
- Experience with **data pipelines / big data.**
- Experience designing and implementing **AutoML** flows/frameworks.

**What soft skills do we appreciate?**

- Fluent English.
- Initiative, proactive person.

**Who we need**
We are looking for a Middle/Senior DevOps Engineer with 3+ years of professional experience to join our growing startup in the hotel industry.

**Requirements
Must have**
- 3+ years of experience with automating cloud-native technologies, deploying applications, and provisioning infrastructure for production-grade systems
- Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code, using Terraform
- Experience with Azure cloud services (Service bus and at least one of these: Event Grid, App services, Azure functions, Logic apps, etc.)
- Experience with cloud monitoring solutions (Azure monitor, App Insights, etc.)
- Experience with Powershell, Python
- At least an Upper-intermediate level of English

**Will be a plus**
- Azure certification
- Knowledge and understanding of SRE practices
- Experience with other Cloud providers: AWS, GCP.

**Responsibilities**
- Build and manage CI/CD pipelines; strive for continuous improvement and automation
- Create infrastructure-as-code using Terraform and/or ARM templates (Azure Resource Manager)
- Work with the team to incorporate automated tests and QC gates as part of the CI/CD pipeline
- Enable monitoring and ensure high availability of cloud services and integration infrastructure on Azure
- Work with security and infrastructure teams to coordinate the deployment according to compliance requirements
- Provide operational support on Incidence management and root cause analysis.

Product**
Our customer is one of the world's most successful hotel companies. Hotel has 118 properties in 47 countries. For the second consecutive year, the hotel was named the Best Luxury Hotel Chain in the world by Business Traveller magazine.

This is a growing product ecosystem. Approximately 2-3 years in development; however, the stack is up to date, with no legacy.

Lviv team: Solutions Architect, Business Analyst, Project Manager, 6 Salesforce Developers, 1 Salesforce Administrator, 1 Marketing Cloud Specialist, 3 QA Engineers. Team on the client's side: only management and several support experts

Full-time working day in our office (flexible hours) or full-time remote.

1-st stage - Call with Recruiter (30 minutes)
2-nd stage - Interview with our Senior Engineer and Recruiter (1 hour)
3-rd stage - Client interview 

**Our Benefits**
- Opportunity to work with the most trending technologies, no legacy, no bureaucracy;
- Work from anywhere (fully remotely or in our office);
- Paid vacations and sick-leaves, additional days-off, relocation bonus;
- Wellness: Medical insurance/ sport compensation/ health check-up+flu vaccination at your choice;
- Education: regular tech-talks, educational courses, paid certifications, English classes;
- Fun: own football team, budget for team-lunches, branded gifts;
- One of the best IT employers in Lviv based on DOU rating.

Medical Insurance after probation period

Official employment enrolled from the 1st day

Provides support to less experienced team members

Advanced knowledge and experience of software development throughout the entire lifecycle
Working knowledge of source control and release management best practices

Experience designing for desktop & mobile platforms using responsive design
Strong communication skills with both internal team members and external business stakeholders
Strong initiative to find ways to improve solutions, systems, and processes

Service oriented architecture (SOA)

They create and publish a diverse portfolio of immersive experiences based on original and beloved franchises for casual and core gamers worldwide, with over 100M+ users across seven #1 mobile games. The client has global operations in Barcelona, Boulder, Dublin, London, Los Angeles, Seoul, Seville, Singapore, and Tokyo. They enjoy challenging work but try to find simple solutions. When joining their growing team, you can expect to own your work from ideation and product definition through production deployment and continued feature maturation. They’re looking for people who take pride in their work and see it impact real people. As part of the game platform, you will join a great team of engineers who provide technology to help studios build and operate games faster and better. The standard technology platform, which enables the business to scale to millions of DAU, offers powerful tools to manage and use live games and accelerates development.
**Requirements:**
5+ years of experience with Java. 
Prior experience with microservices.
Strong computer science and engineering fundamentals (data structures, concurrency, design patterns, algorithms).
Experience in building low-latency, highly available web-scale distributed systems (>500k RPM).
Upper-intermediate English.

Hands-on experience with AWS services.
Cloudformation or similar IaS (Infrastructure as code).
Knowledge of Kubernetes.
Experience in frontend development or Unity.

Competitive compensation plan that takes skills and experience into consideration.
Annual performance appraisals.
Possibility to choose your workspace either remote or combination of your home and one of our development offices. 
Projects that use advanced, cutting-edge technologies.
Competitive bonuses for a personal recommendation of new employees.
Vacation time, sick-leaves, national holidays, family supplementary days off.
Comprehensive medical insurance including dental services, massages.
Support for a healthy lifestyle, compensation of sports events.
Maternity leave policy.
A personal loan budget is available for long-term personnel.
Partial compensation of conferences, courses, and English classes.
Free meetups, webinars, and conferences organized by Svitla.
Birthday and New Year presents for personnel, gifts for children.
Fun summer and winter corporate parties and memorable anniversary presents.

Description
Surprise.com is fundamentally changing how people work, by engaging employees and providing impactful analytics to people operations professionals. To continue scaling our impact, we’re committed to hiring builders who are inspired by our team’s guiding principle: to derive a tremendous sense of purpose to make anything we touch to be the best it can be. To deliver on our very lofty goals, we need engineers with industry-defining talent and an unrestrained drive to deliver flawless results. This role offers tremendous opportunities to build a highly scalable, highly stable, easily-maintainable back-end architecture; to push the boundaries of fault-tolerant programming; and to work with a broad range of public and proprietary APIs.



Your impact

As a Python Engineer at Surprise.com, you will have the ability to shape our application, as well as to help us bring better appreciation and engagement to employees of companies around the world. You’ll work in conjunction with our data scientists, and the rest of the company, in order to help us build delightful and performant software. You’ll have input into the technical roadmap, providing guidance on how to build scalable technical solutions. And you’ll help us figure out how to make the best use of our data, to give new insights to businesses.


Requirements
- Experience in software development 5+ years
- Experience with Python 4+ years
- Practical experience with DS frameworks
- Decent experience with AWS and / or Google Cloud.
- Building microservices and containerized applications (Docker, k8s)
- Proficiency in using database query languages such as SQL and experience of the ETL process
- Experience with NoSQL databases, such as MongoDB, Cassandra, HBase
- Experience with mining of structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data
- RESTfull API creation in Python (Flask, Falcon or similar)
- Understanding of software development process, Agile approach, and CI/CD
- Degree in computer science or related field - Upper-Intermediate English level or higher



Nice to have

- Experience with big data frameworks — Hadoop, Spark
- Understanding of basic Machine Learning techniques
- Knowing of Linear Algebra, Probability and Statistics and Numerical methods
- Applied statistics skills, such as distributions, hypothesis testing, regression analysis, etc.
- Building large-scale recommender engines
- Predictive analytic
- Experience with data visualization tools, such as Ggplot2, Plotly, Matplotlib

This is a new project for DataArt. The team is working in an Agile squad (Morpheus).

**Client**
The Client is a global purpose-led, science-based company specializing in health and nutrition. Their purpose is to create brighter lives for all. They achieve it by using all the scientific and innovation power at their disposal to tackle some of the world's greatest challenges - creating value for customers, shareholders, people, and society-at-large.

**Position Overview**
The Informatica DevOps will need to support the design, development and ongoing support of Data Lake environment. Responsible for defining, deploying and managing next-generation Data Lake and Master Data architectures for our client to enable information transparency and data quality across systems. Individual must have a demonstrated experience with agile project delivery of modern Data Lakes to support Business Intelligence, Data Integrations with increasing responsibility/breadth.
The role includes managing the DSM Data Management platform as an admin - ensuring the environment is up and running; monitoring; testing new release features and deploying into Production. 
This will include operating mainly in the following Informatica modules:
* Administrator / Monitor / Operation Insights,
* Command Center and Ingestion Templates.
The candidate will also support the Data Management team with the correct technical configuration and enable them to use all services.

**Technology Stack**
AWS S3, Redshift, IAM, Informatica Cloud.

**Requirements**
- AWS EC2 Configuration & Management
- Architectural design
- Admin domain experience within Informatica
- Monitoring experience with automated processes to quickly identify and fix an issue
- Strong desire to learn new skills and apply this to solve immediate business issues
- Understanding the impact of data in information and decision management
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to challenge the status quo by presenting a clear factual argument
- Strong communications skills as the role requires interaction with the DNA Squads, Business unit SMEs, and IT teams
- Good English

**Nice to have**
- SaaS Informatica experience
- ELK Stack - Logstash, Elasticsearch, Kibana - useful but not essential
- Understand risk management principles and risk frameworks
- Experience with defining and implementing new software tools within a business
- Ability to challenge and question "as is" across cultural boundaries

iGMS is on a mission to make the lives of vacation rental managers easier by providing robust vacation rental software and automation tools to simplify day-to-day property management tasks. Our award-winning software has been helping hosts and vacation rental businesses streamline routine operations and grow their businesses in over 133 countries.

Being driven by our ambition to become the number one vacation rental software on the market, we are looking for an experienced and energetic PR and Content manager to build and execute PR and content strategies to bring the iGMS’ plans to life.

**This is a full-time remote position with a flexible schedule.** The salary will be based on a candidate’s experience and consist of a fixed and KPI-based part.

**How to apply:**
Send your CV in English + mention your salary expectations

**Responsibilities:**
- Develop and nurture relationships with reporters and influencers in leading publications in hospitality, vacation rental, technology, business, real estate, and other domains
- Secure publications about iGMS in top outlets to increase brand awareness and enhance brand reputation
- Write and develop press releases, pitches, website and blog content, social media content, and thought leadership material
- Leverage online communities by posting relevant content and updates
- Develop and execute communications strategies, plans, calendars, and procedures for communications efforts
- Identify and recommend relevant conferences and events that will elevate the brand and drive quality leads
- Represent the company at events and conferences
- Determine success metrics and report on the results
- Assist in all marketing department’s activities by being actively involved in the marketing strategy development and implementation.

**Requirements:**
- Demonstrated track record of building PR campaigns for tech products or solutions with the measurable outcome
- Impeccable English written and verbal communication skills
- 2+ years of marketing background in a SaaS product company
- Excellent verbal and written communicator and presenter
- Social media expertise and experience (Facebook, LinkedIn, Twitter)
- Ability to write well different types of copy, including press releases, pitches, social media content, blogs, thought leadership pieces, presentations, and more
- Expertise with content distribution spanning across online channels
- Understanding of the latest trends and best practices in marketing and PR
- Outstanding organizational skills and attention to detail.

**Would be a plus:**
- Experience with event management
- Experience in the proptech, hospitality-tech, and knowledge of the current industry trends
- Established contacts with media outlets, bloggers, reporters, etc.
- Experience with marketing automation systems (Hubspot, etc.)
- Working knowledge of WordPress and basic SEO principles

**We offer:**
- Competitive compensation, depending on your work experience
- Work in a young international team
- Full-time remote job
- Flexible schedule
- No-bureaucracy environment
- Opportunities for professional growth and development
- Personalized benefits package

jd:
Our Lizard team needs a proactive developer to join project. We need a candidate who is interested in .NET technical challenges, from working with user and system interfaces to core system development and quality automation. But, this is not just a technical role - to succeed you will have to work with business users (traders) to understand their requirements and how your software is used in production.
We support various set of applications across the Bank within Equites business. One of our main focus is trading platform built on microservices, supporting communication with upstream and downstream systems recipients, serving over three thousand transactions a day. Technology stack used: C#, .NET, SQL Databases, TeamCity, Python.
Our team is mainly situated in two locations: Warsaw, Poland and Zurich, Switzerland. We are working in Kanban and embracing agile principles and values.

Responsibilities:
Initially supporting the on-boarding of a an in-house system, this role is expected to provide the opportunity to become involved with helping perform development & devops (50/50 %) activities to support the ongoing management and enhancements to the clients bespoke system:
• Development, configuration, test case development, and other automation activities
• Significant product enhancements and architecture changes to support new and existing business lines.
• Involvement in Operations activities, like CI/CD setup, environments configurations
• Preparing Proof of Concept, exploring different technical solutions to come up with best development strategy
• Liaising with client management to ensure requirements are captured and delivered successfully
• Handling production issues, supporting BAU requests
You will have opportunity to work with different teams across the Bank, learn the infrastructure around you and code with newer technologies: C#/.NET from 4.5 and above, ReactJS.

Mandatory Skills Description:
Strong C# knowledge (3-5 years of experience)
• Background in DevOps
• Proficiency with Git, Jira and automated deployment tools.
• Good communications in both written and spoken form
• Experience working with large distributed systems
• Work with microservices, web-services, MS SQL databases
• CI/CD knowledge (TeamCity)

Nice-to-Have Skills:
C#/.NET WCF, REST
• NancyFX, HTTPS, WebAPI, MQ, FTPS
• DNS, LoadBalancing
• Scripting / Automation skills
• ReactJS experience would be beneficial
• Experience of capital markets systems


Residence in Poland is mandatory

Must have skills:

2+ years of Java experience, developing distributed web systems in Java
- Strong OO-design and -programming skills preferred
- Experience of the Spring Framework (Core, MVC, Boot)
- Experience of developing RESTful APIs
- Experience in server-side development of services
- Experience in the design and development of message-oriented, service-based solutions
- Experience in creating modular systems and API design
- Experience writing software using Test-Driven Development principles

Is merit:
- Experience with highly available, scalable and fault-tolerant systems is a plus
- Experience with JavaScript

Preferences

Service Oriented Architecture (SOA), Agile, Docker, Spring Cloud, JMS

- Designs should be based on sound SOA best practices that support modular integrated design concepts
- Assess, Design, and Deliver an Integration Architecture that supports High Availability and Scalability

We Offer

Exciting Projects: Come take your place at the forefront of digital transformation! With clients across all industries and sectors, we offer an opportunity to participate in creating market-defining products using the latest technologies.

Collaborative Environment: Expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!

Professional Development: Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes certification and technical / soft skill training to help you realize your professional goals.

By creating an environment that is exciting and flexible, and by fostering growth through ongoing learning and development programs, we empower our consultants to achieve both their professional and personal goals.

At GlobalLogic, we make amazing products — and careers.

We are looking for two exceptional full stack developers with ruby experience to work alongside the Founder (current product owner) and Castle (current dev team) to make a real impact on the web application at the core of our business.

These two people will be the first members of our in-house tech team and will help build the team around them in the next 1-3 years. Technology underpins our entire business, and we are constantly working to improve our core product and add new features.

About us

My Bespoke Room is a UK based SaaS and B2C business. Our award-winning on-line interior service is ranked the #1 in the UK. We have recently launched Design Pal Pro; a new SaaS product which allows designers to use our technology to set-up, run and grow their own business.

Our mission is that anyone and everyone can have a beautiful home whatever their style & budget. We want to continue to disrupt an industry by using technology to automate and improve the design and online shopping process.

Responsibilities
- Working on any and all parts of our technology stack, developing frontend and backend of the application using Ruby on Rails, JavaScript, React, HTML and SASS
- Engage in working collaboratively with the dev team and product owner in designing new features and updating existing ones
- Bug fixing existing code
- Helping to overcome roadblocks to planned development in collaboration with product owner
- Engineering solutions to any issues we face as our business scales, applying new technologies and approaches as appropriate
- Building cutting-edge technology that will continue to disrupt an industry

Our technology

Some of the technologies that we are currently using are:
- Ruby On Rails code base
- Database is PostgreSQL
- For cache Redis
- Front end is built on React and some scripts on jquery
- AWS
- Hubspot integration
- Paypal and Stripe for payment integration

Our ideal candidate
- A degree in computer science or similar
- Aren’t afraid to get stuck in and work across the complete technology stack
- Have solid experience (3 years +) in Ruby on Rails
- Proven experience working with databases (beyond ORM basics)
- Love implementing new features from start to finish, following them through to testing and deployment
- Ability to speak English essential and have strong communication skills
- A collaborator who is comfortable working in pair programming

A few ways to stand out
- Experience with Docker
- Proficiency with a frontend famework (React, Angular, Backbone etc)

Salary and Benefits
- $6000-7000 per month (depending on experience)
- Full time flexible schedule. UK hours preferable.
- 20 days holiday a year, plus holidays in the country you are living in (plus your birthday off)
- Being the initial members of the in-house tech team, you can make a real impact
- Relaxed working environment and work-life flexibility

**ABOUT THE ROLE **

Talents on TikTok are the DNA of TIKTAL, as an influencer campaign manager, you’re going to be a key asset, between influencers and brands. our clients!

As an influencer campaign manager you’re going to be directly in touch with influencers, briefing and negotiating, building your network with talent managers, and other agencies in the industry while working directly with the brands.

You’re going to make a lot of decisions impacting directly the campaign performance and profitability

KEY ACTIVITIES

Develop and execute influencer marketing strategies and creative campaigns
Preparing the influencer brief with the brand requirements.
Contacting influencers via Email, phone, Hangout/Zoom, Snapchat...
Follow up with influencers who showed interested
Negotiate with influencers, talent managers, and other agencies (Agreement, price negotiation, videos to produce)
Jumping on meeting with influencers and brand representatives.
Analyze, and select the best influencers fitting for the campaign
Preparing, sending, and signing agreements
Reply to any question influencers might have about the campaign
Keeping up to date the status of each influencer from the first contact to the video posting.
Keeping track of the video posted and reporting to the brand
Submit influencers to the brand for review and approval
Communicate with the brand general influencer info
Debrief with the brand on a weekly basis
Present full reporting from the campaign focused on brands goals.
EXPECTATIONS

During each campaign, the team will be working alongside you in various parts of the process. We expect you to be able to decide what’s best for the brand in terms of performance and on the other hand meet influencer expectations.

The organization is key to successfully manage your campaigns. You must be able to meet deadlines and keep track of every single step of the process from start to finish.

This is a full-time role in which you have the opportunity to grow as quickly as the agency is growing.

**REQUIREMENTS **

Already worked remotely for over a year.
Genuine interest in TikTok, and influencer marketing
Proven track record in outreach campaign strategies
In-depth knowledge of the social media marketing industry
Impeccable verbal and written communication skills
Very well organized with great time management skills
Outstanding project management skills
Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building skills
Networking aptitude
Qualities and Skills:

Being able to work well with other members of the department team.
Trustworthy and accurate as you will be dealing with highly confidential material.
Outstanding communication skills.
Strong attention to detail.
Can-do attitude.
A passion for, and knowledge of influencer marketing and TikTok.
COMPENSATION

$500 basis per month + performance bonus

Job Posting

HostPapa Engineering is growing and we're looking for Backend and Full Stack Developers to add to the team! Help us shape and build the future of our hosting platform. We believe in empowering our developers to innovate and implement the technologies and solutions that best suit the problem at hand.

What will you do?
Build and integrate scalable, geo-distributed, microservices with a focus on performance and maintainability in a variety of languages and platforms including, but not limited to, PHP, TypeScript, AWS Lambda, Kubernetes, and more.
Create and improve automated testing to ensure the long-term stability of our applications including unit tests, acceptance tests, and static analysis, all integrated with our continuous integration environment for seamless peer reviews and deployments.
Collaborate with peers by performing code reviews in pull requests and staging environments, discussing implementation details for new projects in planning and refinement sessions, and improving our local development environment and tools.
Continually progress in your career by working with Engineering leadership to ensure challenges and opportunities that will help you grow are put before you.
What’s it like to work here?
In HostPapa Engineering we trust every member to put in the work, hit deadlines agreed upon by the team after scoping the work to be done, all while ensuring a work-life balance and flexible schedule. You will work in a cross-functional scrum team made up of other Backend, Full Stack, and Frontend developers to tackle many of the interesting problems HostPapa faces. We are a self-sufficient team responsible for our work all the way to production so we built the processes to make peer reviews painless and staging-based testing as accurate as possible.

Technologies we use
PHP / PHPUnit / Codeception
Angular / React / ES6 Javascript
Kubernetes / Docker / Vagrant
AWS - Lambda, Cloudformation, API Gateway, Route 53
TypeScript / Go / Python / Bash
Jest / Cypress
Grow With Us
We believe in personal growth while on the job and will work with you throughout your time at HostPapa to ensure you’re evolving and leveling up in your career. Additionally, we offer the following:

Fully remote with flexible hours. We’re remote to the core with processes and tools in place to help you succeed just days after joining the team.
Education reimbursement. Whether it’s certifications or access to online learning portals, we want everyone to learn and grow while working at HostPapa.
About HostPapa
HostPapa Inc. is one of Canada’s fastest-growing technology companies with over 180,000 customers worldwide. We help individuals and small-to-medium-sized businesses deliver their online dreams by hosting and supporting their websites, email, and cloud-based solutions, all backed by award-winning customer service.

We are a globally distributed company with over 250 team members. We believe in the power of remote work, all you need is a good internet connection. We trust our team members to help determine what's possible and to then deliver on those commitments.

jd: The project is the compilation process of our map data for (company NDA) . We are looking for a person who can take over this role on a long term basis. This would mean, to learn how to use our existing tools, understand the content of the data and, eventually, improve the compilation process with us. Most of the time, the data compilation does not change. If data provider leaves their data format unchanged, then the compilation should smoothly run (semi) automatically. Only if the data provider changes something or if we change our format, then the compilation process needs to be adapted accordingly. Usually the data compilation process does not run smoothly from start to end. Oftentimes some little detail has been changed in the raw data or in our software that reads the data. This needs to be debugged and the compilation software must be changed accordingly. The process is a mixture of manual and automated steps. There is a range of tools which perform different tasks and which must be executed one after the other. The tools themselves are written in C and C++. The process is quite complex and needs to be understood. However, once you have understood it, it is mostly repetitive. There is certainly some potential for optimization (speed and degree of automization) but it is not a task that requires a lot of creativity.

Requirements development, requirements review, ticket estimations

Sharing new ideas and techniques and methodologies

Agile, team-oriented, and proactive mentality

Confident level of English for daily communication

Experience in Java
